title: Signed, Sealed, Leaked: Trust Beyond Signature for MCP Toolchains
title_zh: 签名、封印与泄露：MCP 工具链中超越签名的信任

paragraphs.en: AI agents rely on third-party tools, such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, whose publishers can be authenticated and whose execution can be restricted by runtime security policies. Yet authenticity does not guarantee benign behaviour: a legitimately signed tool may perform its advertised function while concealing malicious code that leaks confidential information. We demonstrate this trust failure with a signed MCP tool that embeds sensitive data in requests to a policy-allowed destination. Meta’s MCPGuard-Dynamic, a state-of-the-art runtime defence, blocks a direct exfiltration attempt in the same run, yet fails to prevent this attack in every trial. We introduce germline execution, which limits information disclosure without inspecting or trusting tool implementations. Each tool invocation runs in ephemeral copies forked from a data-free germline process, each receiving only information authorised for its destination. Even if malicious code executes, what it can disclose is bounded by the data available to its copy. Under explicit assumptions on copy confinement and a data-free germline, we prove sink noninterference for every signed release and, for releases deterministic within our replay model, show that a verified witness establishes a flow violation. Across 153 attack runs, no unauthorised disclosure was detected under germline execution, compared with 5.9–74.5% of runs under baseline defences and an ablation. Invocations served by a single copy completed in 10–49 ms, 2–28 × \times faster than restarting the tool for every invocation, the conventional way to clear state. These results show that data-isolated execution protects agent toolchains against malicious code concealed within authenticated software.

paragraphs.en: AI agents now act by calling tools. Through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) [ 1 ] , tool calls have become the new API layer of software: an agent hands a user’s documents, databases and messages to third-party tools that run as long-lived processes next to it. Ecosystems trust these tools through code signing and pinned publisher keys, from TUF-style metadata [ 2 ] and Sigstore [ 3 ] to signed agent-skill catalogues [ 4 ] . A signature, however, proves only who published the exact bytes, not what the bytes do once they run. Malicious code can therefore be embedded inside a trusted, signed tool: the tool does its advertised job while a hidden routine, like a Trojan, leaks the user’s data. This is not hypothetical. The XZ backdoor [ 5 ] showed that maintainer-signed releases can carry hidden code, and agent tools show the same pattern in skill backdoors [ 6 ] , exfiltrating MCP servers [ 7 ] and backdoored copies of legitimate agent extensions [ 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体现在通过调用工具来执行操作。 通过模型上下文协议（MCP）[ 1 ]，工具调用已成为软件新的 API 层：智能体将用户的文档、数据库和消息交给以长驻进程形式运行在它旁边的第三方工具。 生态系统通过代码签名和固定的发布者密钥来信任这些工具，从 TUF 风格的元数据 [ 2 ] 和 Sigstore [ 3 ] 到经过签名的智能体技能目录 [ 4 ]。 然而，签名只能证明是谁发布了这些确切的字节，而不能证明这些字节在运行后会做什么。 因此，恶意代码可以被嵌入到一个受信任的、已签名的工具中：该工具在完成其宣称的功能的同时，一个隐藏的例程（如木马）会泄露用户的数据。 这并非假设。 XZ 后门 [ 5 ] 表明，由维护者签名的发布版本可能携带隐藏代码，而智能体工具也呈现出同样的模式，体现在技能后门 [ 6 ]、数据外泄的 MCP 服务器 [ 7 ] 以及被植入后门的合法智能体扩展副本 [ 8 ] 中。

paragraphs.en: Runtime defences go beyond the signature: confinement such as AgentBound [ 9 ] and MCPGuard-Dynamic [ 10 ] limits the files and destinations a tool may reach, and agent information-flow control (IFC) such as FIDES [ 11 ] and CaMeL [ 12 ] labels tool replies. Neither is designed for a Trojan in the tool’s own code that slips stolen data into a request to a destination the tool is allowed to use, by carrying data across calls or mixing the items of one call.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时防御不仅限于签名：诸如 AgentBound [ 9 ] 和 MCPGuard-Dynamic [ 10 ] 之类的隔离机制可以限制工具可访问的文件和目标，而诸如 FIDES [ 11 ] 和 CaMeL [ 12 ] 之类的智能体信息流控制（IFC）会对工具的回复打标签。 两者都不是针对工具自身代码中的木马而设计的：这类木马通过跨调用携带数据或混合单次调用的各个条目，把窃取的数据混入发往工具被允许使用的目标的请求中。

paragraphs.en: Even the state-of-the-art defence misses it. We ran Meta’s MCPGuard-Dynamic, a recent open-source kernel-level defence for MCP tool calls, with least-privilege policies for a six-call session over HR, board, finance and public items. In its strongest evaluated configuration (per-call policy enforcement with its eBPF controls active), its egress control works as designed: in the same run, a raw-socket transfer to an unlisted host is blocked in every trial. Yet a signed release of an OCR tool, pool , keeps items from earlier calls and discloses them inside the next request to the authorised OCR destination, in every trial and under all seven MCPGuard configurations; smuggle does the same with permitted files the call did not need ( Table I ). For pool , no disclosure was detected under germline execution, the mechanism we propose; smuggle is measured in our scripted matrix. The pattern holds beyond these releases: across 91 variants we generated, an egress allowlist of this class stops all 71 that send to an attacker-owned host but none of the 20 that send to a policy-allowed host ( Section VII-C ). This marks the boundary of destination-based confinement, not an implementation flaw: MCPGuard decides where a process may send data and does not promise item-level information-flow control. Because the attack needs nothing more than publishing a signed tool or update, a signed Trojan is one of the most direct ways to attack an agentic AI system.
paragraphs.zh: 即使是最先进的防御也会漏掉它。 我们运行了 Meta 的 MCPGuard-Dynamic——一款近期开源的面向 MCP 工具调用的内核级防御，并以最小权限策略处理一个涉及人力资源、董事会、财务和公开项目的六次调用会话。 在其最强的已评估配置中（逐调用策略执行且其 eBPF 控制处于激活状态），其出口控制按设计工作：在同一运行中，向未列出主机的原始套接字传输在每次试验中都被阻止。 然而某 OCR 工具的一个签名版本 pool 会保留此前调用中的条目，并在下一次发往已授权 OCR 目的地的请求中泄露这些条目，在每次试验中且在全部七种 MCPGuard 配置下均是如此；smuggle 则对该调用并不需要的允许文件做同样的事（表 I）。 对于 pool，在我们提出的机制——种系执行——下未检测到任何泄露；smuggle 则在我们的脚本化矩阵中进行测量。 这一模式在这些版本之外依然成立：在我们生成的 91 个变体中，此类出口允许列表阻止了全部 71 个向攻击者自有主机发送数据的变体，但 20 个向策略允许主机发送数据的变体一个也未能阻止（第 VII-C 节）。 这标志着基于目的地的约束的边界，而非实现缺陷：MCPGuard 决定进程可以向哪里发送数据，并不承诺条目级的信息流控制。 由于该攻击只需要发布一个签名的工具或更新，签名的木马是攻击智能体 AI 系统最直接的方式之一。

paragraphs.en: Invocation purity. Per-call output labelling relies on what we call invocation purity : what a call sends to a destination depends only on data that destination may see. Destination-based confinement relies on it as well whenever its destination policy is taken as assurance that each destination receives only items it may see. A long-lived tool process violates it by carrying state across calls ( pool ) or mixing items of different clearance within one call ( smuggle ; Section II-C ).
paragraphs.zh: 调用纯净性。 逐次调用输出标记依赖于我们所说的调用纯净性：一次调用发送到某个目的地的内容仅取决于该目的地可能看到的数据。 基于目的地的约束在将目的地策略作为每个目的地仅收到其可见内容的保证时，同样依赖于此性质。 长生命周期的工具进程会在多次调用之间携带状态（pool），或在一次调用中混入不同密级的内容（smuggle；第II-C节），从而违反该性质。

paragraphs.en: Germline execution. Instead of judging whether a tool’s code can be trusted, our mechanism controls what data the code can see. Every call runs in disposable copies of the tool, forked from a clean germline process that never holds user data, and each copy receives only the data its destination may see; the copies are discarded after the call. Hidden code still runs, but it has nothing to leak: whatever it sends to a destination, that destination was already allowed to see. Formally, the mechanism enforces one invariant from outside the tool: a request to a destination depends only on the items that destination is cleared to see in the current call, on state kept for its clearance horizon, on replies it may receive and on public inputs. Before the tool runs, a Plan step groups the consumers and declared destinations by the items each may see, its view , and the germline forks one sandboxed copy per group. Groups follow declared destinations, so which copies exist never depends on secret data, and state crosses calls only through per-horizon slots held outside the copies. Prevention rests on these copies alone; a separate evidence layer of twin copies and verifiable witnesses exposes releases whose requests diverge, and a dampening policy adapted from BGP route-flap damping [ 13 ] suppresses repeat offenders. We build on secure multi-execution [ 14 ] and per-request state reset [ 15 ] ; Section II-D states what is new when the adversary is the signed tool itself.
paragraphs.zh: 种系执行。 我们的机制不是判断工具的代码是否可信，而是控制该代码能看到哪些数据。 每次调用都在该工具的一次性副本中运行，这些副本从一个从不保存用户数据的干净种系进程分叉而来，且每个副本只接收其目的地可以看到的数据；调用结束后副本即被丢弃。 隐藏代码仍会运行，但它没有任何可泄露的东西：无论它向某个目的地发送什么，该目的地本来就已被允许看到这些内容。 形式化地说，该机制从工具外部强制维护一个不变式：对某个目的地的请求仅依赖于该目的地在当前调用中被许可查看的条目、为其许可范围保存的状态、它可能收到的回复以及公开输入。 在工具运行之前，一个计划（Plan）步骤按每个消费者和已声明目的地可以看到的条目（即其视图）对它们进行分组，种系进程为每个组分叉一个沙箱化副本。 组的划分遵循已声明的目的地，因此存在哪些副本从不依赖于秘密数据，而状态只能通过保存在副本之外、按许可范围划分的槽位跨调用传递。 防护仅依赖这些副本；一个由孪生副本和可验证见证者构成的独立证据层会暴露请求出现分歧的泄露行为，而一种改编自 BGP 路由抖动抑制（route-flap damping）[13] 的抑制策略则会压制屡犯者。 我们的工作建立在安全多执行 [14] 和按请求状态重置 [15] 之上；第 II-D 节阐述了当对手正是这个经过签名的工具本身时，有哪些新的内容。

sents.en: Germline execution.
sents.zh: 种系执行。

sents.en: Instead of judging whether a tool’s code can be trusted, our mechanism controls what data the code can see.
sents.zh: 我们的机制不是判断工具的代码是否可信，而是控制该代码能看到哪些数据。

sents.en: Every call runs in disposable copies of the tool, forked from a clean germline process that never holds user data, and each copy receives only the data its destination may see; the copies are discarded after the call.
sents.zh: 每次调用都在该工具的一次性副本中运行，这些副本从一个从不保存用户数据的干净种系进程分叉而来，且每个副本只接收其目的地可以看到的数据；调用结束后副本即被丢弃。

sents.en: Hidden code still runs, but it has nothing to leak: whatever it sends to a destination, that destination was already allowed to see.
sents.zh: 隐藏代码仍会运行，但它没有任何可泄露的东西：无论它向某个目的地发送什么，该目的地本来就已被允许看到这些内容。

sents.en: Formally, the mechanism enforces one invariant from outside the tool: a request to a destination depends only on the items that destination is cleared to see in the current call, on state kept for its clearance horizon, on replies it may receive and on public inputs.
sents.zh: 形式化地说，该机制从工具外部强制维护一个不变式：对某个目的地的请求仅依赖于该目的地在当前调用中被许可查看的条目、为其许可范围保存的状态、它可能收到的回复以及公开输入。

sents.en: Before the tool runs, a Plan step groups the consumers and declared destinations by the items each may see, its view , and the germline forks one sandboxed copy per group.
sents.zh: 在工具运行之前，一个计划（Plan）步骤按每个消费者和已声明目的地可以看到的条目（即其视图）对它们进行分组，种系进程为每个组分叉一个沙箱化副本。

sents.en: Groups follow declared destinations, so which copies exist never depends on secret data, and state crosses calls only through per-horizon slots held outside the copies.
sents.zh: 组的划分遵循已声明的目的地，因此存在哪些副本从不依赖于秘密数据，而状态只能通过保存在副本之外、按许可范围划分的槽位跨调用传递。

sents.en: Prevention rests on these copies alone; a separate evidence layer of twin copies and verifiable witnesses exposes releases whose requests diverge, and a dampening policy adapted from BGP route-flap damping [ 13 ] suppresses repeat offenders.
sents.zh: 防护仅依赖这些副本；一个由孪生副本和可验证见证者构成的独立证据层会暴露请求出现分歧的泄露行为，而一种改编自 BGP 路由抖动抑制（route-flap damping）[13] 的抑制策略则会压制屡犯者。

sents.en: We build on secure multi-execution [ 14 ] and per-request state reset [ 15 ] ; Section II-D states what is new when the adversary is the signed tool itself.
sents.zh: 我们的工作建立在安全多执行 [14] 和按请求状态重置 [15] 之上；第 II-D 节阐述了当对手正是这个经过签名的工具本身时，有哪些新的内容。

paragraphs.en: Contributions. This paper makes three contributions.
paragraphs.zh: 贡献。 本文做出三项贡献。

sents.en: Contributions.
sents.zh: 贡献。

sents.en: This paper makes three contributions.
sents.zh: 本文做出三项贡献。

paragraphs.en: The gap. We identify invocation purity as the assumption behind per-call output labelling and behind item-level readings of destination-based confinement, separate its two failure modes, and demonstrate both against MCPGuard-Dynamic ( Sections II-C and VII-B ).
paragraphs.zh: 差距所在。 我们识别出调用纯净性（invocation purity）是每次调用输出标注以及基于目的地的隔离的条目级解读背后的假设，区分其两种失效模式，并在 MCPGuard-Dynamic 上对两者进行验证（第 II-C 节和第 VII-B 节）。

sents.en: The gap.
sents.zh: 差距所在。

sents.en: We identify invocation purity as the assumption behind per-call output labelling and behind item-level readings of destination-based confinement, separate its two failure modes, and demonstrate both against MCPGuard-Dynamic ( Sections II-C and VII-B ).
sents.zh: 我们识别出调用纯净性（invocation purity）是每次调用输出标注以及基于目的地的隔离的条目级解读背后的假设，区分其两种失效模式，并在 MCPGuard-Dynamic 上对两者进行验证（第 II-C 节和第 VII-B 节）。

paragraphs.en: Germline execution and its guarantees. Under stated confinement and data-free-germline assumptions we prove sink noninterference for every signed release and output labels that cover stored state; a verified witness proves a flow violation for tools deterministic within the replay model; and Plan uses the fewest copies of any black-box mechanism with data-independent run selection ( Sections IV and V ).
paragraphs.zh: 胚系执行及其保证。 在所述的受限环境与无数据胚系假设下，我们证明了每个签名发布版本的汇点非干扰性，以及覆盖已存储状态的输出标签；经验证的见证可以证明在重放模型内具有确定性的工具存在流违规；并且 Plan 在具有数据无关运行选择的黑盒机制中使用的副本数量最少（第 IV 和 V 节）。

sents.en: Germline execution and its guarantees.
sents.zh: 胚系执行及其保证。

sents.en: Under stated confinement and data-free-germline assumptions we prove sink noninterference for every signed release and output labels that cover stored state; a verified witness proves a flow violation for tools deterministic within the replay model; and Plan uses the fewest copies of any black-box mechanism with data-independent run selection ( Sections IV and V ).
sents.zh: 在所述的受限环境与无数据胚系假设下，我们证明了每个签名发布版本的汇点非干扰性，以及覆盖已存储状态的输出标签；经验证的见证可以证明在重放模型内具有确定性的工具存在流违规；并且 Plan 在具有数据无关运行选择的黑盒机制中使用的副本数量最少（第 IV 和 V 节）。

paragraphs.en: Prototype and evaluation. We implement Germline for unmodified Python MCP servers on stock Linux and answer five research questions. No canary disclosure was detected in 153 attack runs (baselines and an ablation: 5.9–74.5%), in 91 variants we generated, or with an LLM-driven agent that completes 7 of 7 tasks; single-copy calls take 10–49 ms, 2–28 × \times faster than a fresh process per call ( Sections VI and VII ).
paragraphs.zh: 原型与评估。 我们在原版 Linux 上为未经修改的 Python MCP 服务器实现了 Germline，并回答了五个研究问题。 在 153 次攻击运行（基线与消融实验：5.9–74.5%）、我们生成的 91 个变体中，以及在一个能完成 7 项任务全部 7 项的 LLM 驱动智能体下，均未检测到金丝雀披露；单次调用耗时 10–49 毫秒，比每次调用启动新进程快 2–28 × \times 倍（第 VI 节和第 VII 节）。

sents.en: Prototype and evaluation.
sents.zh: 原型与评估。

sents.zh: 我们在原版 Linux 上为未经修改的 Python MCP 服务器实现了 Germline，并回答了五个研究问题。

sents.en: No canary disclosure was detected in 153 attack runs (baselines and an ablation: 5.9–74.5%), in 91 variants we generated, or with an LLM-driven agent that completes 7 of 7 tasks; single-copy calls take 10–49 ms, 2–28 × \times faster than a fresh process per call ( Sections VI and VII ).

paragraphs.en: An MCP server exposes callable functions, called tools, to an agent host over JSON-RPC [ 1 ] . Local servers are ordinary processes that the host usually starts once and keeps alive for the whole agent session [ 9 ] , so one process receives the inputs of every call it serves.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 服务器通过 JSON-RPC [ 1 ] 向智能体宿主暴露可调用的函数，即工具。 本地服务器是普通进程，宿主通常只启动一次并在整个智能体会话期间保持其存活 [ 9 ] ，因此一个进程会接收它所服务的每一次调用的输入。

sents.en: An MCP server exposes callable functions, called tools, to an agent host over JSON-RPC [ 1 ] .
sents.zh: MCP 服务器通过 JSON-RPC [ 1 ] 向智能体宿主暴露可调用的函数，即工具。

sents.en: Local servers are ordinary processes that the host usually starts once and keeps alive for the whole agent session [ 9 ] , so one process receives the inputs of every call it serves.
sents.zh: 本地服务器是普通进程，宿主通常只启动一次并在整个智能体会话期间保持其存活 [ 9 ] ，因此一个进程会接收它所服务的每一次调用的输入。

paragraphs.en: A release is one exact signed package version (manifest, code and dependencies), identified by its hash. The publisher signs it with an Ed25519 key [ 16 ] , TUF-style metadata [ 2 ] names the current release, and the host pins the publisher key and verifies every later release. This chain authenticates provenance and promises nothing about what those bytes do with the data they receive: a hidden routine, or a dependency bumped to a compromised version, is covered by the signature like the code around it ( Fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 发布（release）是指一个确切的已签名包版本（清单、代码和依赖），由其哈希值标识。 发布者使用 Ed25519 密钥 [16] 对其签名，TUF 风格的元数据 [2] 指明当前发布，主机固定发布者密钥并验证之后的每一次发布。 这条链验证了来源的真实性，但对这些字节如何处理其接收到的数据不作任何承诺：一段隐藏的例程，或一个被升级到受感染版本的依赖，都会像其周围的代码一样被签名所覆盖（图 1）。

sents.en: A release is one exact signed package version (manifest, code and dependencies), identified by its hash.
sents.zh: 发布（release）是指一个确切的已签名包版本（清单、代码和依赖），由其哈希值标识。

sents.en: The publisher signs it with an Ed25519 key [ 16 ] , TUF-style metadata [ 2 ] names the current release, and the host pins the publisher key and verifies every later release.
sents.zh: 发布者使用 Ed25519 密钥 [16] 对其签名，TUF 风格的元数据 [2] 指明当前发布，主机固定发布者密钥并验证之后的每一次发布。

sents.en: This chain authenticates provenance and promises nothing about what those bytes do with the data they receive: a hidden routine, or a dependency bumped to a compromised version, is covered by the signature like the code around it ( Fig. 1 ).
sents.zh: 这条链验证了来源的真实性，但对这些字节如何处理其接收到的数据不作任何承诺：一段隐藏的例程，或一个被升级到受感染版本的依赖，都会像其周围的代码一样被签名所覆盖（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Each defence beyond the signature binds authority to one object ( Table VIII ). Pre-deployment analyses and honey tests bind it to the code before it runs [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , where dormant routines can stay inactive. Confinement binds it to the server process and the destination hosts it may reach, where a destination host is the target host of a request, identified by its DNS name or IP address, with all its ports and paths; we say destination from here on. AgentBound enforces a per-server manifest in a session-long container [ 9 ] , and MCPGuard-Dynamic an eBPF/BPF-LSM policy on files, programs and destinations, optionally re-applied on each call [ 10 ] . Both stop contact with unlisted hosts; the content of a request to an allowed host is outside their design scope.
paragraphs.zh: 签名之后的每一道防御都将权限绑定到一个对象（表 VIII）。 部署前分析和蜜罐测试在其运行之前将其绑定到代码 [17, 18, 19]，其中休眠的例程可能保持不活跃状态。 隔离将其绑定到服务器进程及其可能到达的目标主机，其中目标主机是某个请求的目标主机，由其 DNS 名称或 IP 地址标识，包含其所有端口和路径；下文简称目标。 AgentBound 在一个会话级容器中强制执行每服务器清单 [9]，MCPGuard-Dynamic 则在文件、程序和目标上强制执行 eBPF/BPF-LSM 策略，并可选择在每次调用时重新应用 [10]。 两者都能阻止与未列入清单的主机的联系；而发送到允许主机的请求内容则超出了它们的设计范围。

sents.en: Each defence beyond the signature binds authority to one object ( Table VIII ).
sents.zh: 签名之后的每一道防御都将权限绑定到一个对象（表 VIII）。

sents.en: Pre-deployment analyses and honey tests bind it to the code before it runs [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] , where dormant routines can stay inactive.

sents.zh: 隔离将其绑定到服务器进程及其可能到达的目标主机，其中目标主机是某个请求的目标主机，由其 DNS 名称或 IP 地址标识，包含其所有端口和路径；下文简称目标。

sents.en: AgentBound enforces a per-server manifest in a session-long container [ 9 ] , and MCPGuard-Dynamic an eBPF/BPF-LSM policy on files, programs and destinations, optionally re-applied on each call [ 10 ] .
sents.zh: AgentBound 在一个会话级容器中强制执行每服务器清单 [9]，MCPGuard-Dynamic 则在文件、程序和目标上强制执行 eBPF/BPF-LSM 策略，并可选择在每次调用时重新应用 [10]。

sents.zh: 两者都能阻止与未列入清单的主机的联系；而发送到允许主机的请求内容则超出了它们的设计范围。

paragraphs.en: Agent information-flow control (IFC) binds labels to data. CaMeL [ 12 ] and, as described in its paper, FIDES [ 11 ] label each tool reply chiefly from the tool’s identity and the current call’s inputs (in CaMeL, also from the reply’s content type) and block flows to consumers not cleared for the label. This is correct when the reply depends on the current call alone; Section VII-C shows a stateful reply that CaMeL labels public.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体信息流控制（IFC）将标签绑定到数据上。 CaMeL [ 12 ] 以及如其论文所述的 FIDES [ 11 ] 主要根据工具的身份和当前调用的输入为每条工具回复打标签（在 CaMeL 中，还根据回复的内容类型），并阻止流向未获得该标签许可的接收方的数据流。 当回复仅取决于当前调用时，这是正确的；第 VII-C 节展示了一个有状态的回复，而 CaMeL 将其标记为公开。

sents.en: Agent information-flow control (IFC) binds labels to data.
sents.zh: 智能体信息流控制（IFC）将标签绑定到数据上。

sents.en: CaMeL [ 12 ] and, as described in its paper, FIDES [ 11 ] label each tool reply chiefly from the tool’s identity and the current call’s inputs (in CaMeL, also from the reply’s content type) and block flows to consumers not cleared for the label.
sents.zh: CaMeL [ 12 ] 以及如其论文所述的 FIDES [ 11 ] 主要根据工具的身份和当前调用的输入为每条工具回复打标签（在 CaMeL 中，还根据回复的内容类型），并阻止流向未获得该标签许可的接收方的数据流。

sents.en: This is correct when the reply depends on the current call alone; Section VII-C shows a stateful reply that CaMeL labels public.
sents.zh: 当回复仅取决于当前调用时，这是正确的；第 VII-C 节展示了一个有状态的回复，而 CaMeL 将其标记为公开。

paragraphs.en: Request-reset isolation restores a clean state before each request, by snapshot and restore in Groundhog [ 15 ] or by a fresh process per call, our baseline; items of one call still share a process.
paragraphs.zh: 请求重置隔离在每次请求前恢复到干净状态，通过 Groundhog [ 15 ] 中的快照与恢复机制，或每次调用使用全新进程（即我们的基线）；但同一次调用的各项内容仍共享一个进程。

paragraphs.en: Per-call output labelling rests on one expectation, which we call invocation purity : a call sends each destination only data that destination may see. Destination-based confinement does not itself require it, but a deployment that reads a destination policy as item-level confidentiality relies on it. The invariant we enforce is that a request to destination d d depends only on d d ’s cleared current items, d d ’s horizon state, admissible replies and public inputs (the release, metadata and public nondeterminism such as the clock). Returned values obey the same rule through their labels ( Corollary 2 ); Definition 5 is the formal version. A hidden routine can break the invariant in two ways without violating a confinement or labelling policy.
paragraphs.zh: 按次调用输出标注基于一个预期，我们称之为调用纯粹性：一次调用只向每个目的地发送该目的地可见的数据。 基于目的地的约束本身并不要求这一点，但将目的地策略解读为条目级机密性的部署依赖于它。 我们强制执行的不变式是：对目的地 d d 的请求仅依赖于 d d 已核准的当前条目、d d 的视界状态、可采纳的回复以及公共输入（发布内容、元数据和时钟等公共非确定性）。 返回值通过其标签遵循相同的规则（推论 2）；定义 5 是其形式化版本。 隐藏的例程可以以两种方式破坏该不变式，而不违反任何约束或标注策略。

sents.en: Per-call output labelling rests on one expectation, which we call invocation purity : a call sends each destination only data that destination may see.
sents.zh: 按次调用输出标注基于一个预期，我们称之为调用纯粹性：一次调用只向每个目的地发送该目的地可见的数据。

sents.en: Destination-based confinement does not itself require it, but a deployment that reads a destination policy as item-level confidentiality relies on it.
sents.zh: 基于目的地的约束本身并不要求这一点，但将目的地策略解读为条目级机密性的部署依赖于它。

sents.en: The invariant we enforce is that a request to destination d d depends only on d d ’s cleared current items, d d ’s horizon state, admissible replies and public inputs (the release, metadata and public nondeterminism such as the clock).
sents.zh: 我们强制执行的不变式是：对目的地 d d 的请求仅依赖于 d d 已核准的当前条目、d d 的视界状态、可采纳的回复以及公共输入（发布内容、元数据和时钟等公共非确定性）。

sents.en: Returned values obey the same rule through their labels ( Corollary 2 ); Definition 5 is the formal version.
sents.zh: 返回值通过其标签遵循相同的规则（推论 2）；定义 5 是其形式化版本。

sents.en: A hidden routine can break the invariant in two ways without violating a confinement or labelling policy.
sents.zh: 隐藏的例程可以以两种方式破坏该不变式，而不违反任何约束或标注策略。

paragraphs.en: The first failure mode is cross-call state . In our running example ( Fig. 2 a–b), the carry-over Trojan pool in ocr_pdf keeps a salary sheet labelled hr from an earlier call. When a later call sends an invoice labelled finance to the declared destination ocr.example , which is cleared for finance data, the hidden routine appends the salary sheet. The signature is valid, the destination is allowed and the reply carries the invoice’s label, yet the salary sheet reaches a host not cleared for it; a fresh process per call would remove the stash.
paragraphs.zh: 第一种失败模式是跨调用状态。 在我们的运行示例（图 2 a–b）中，ocr_pdf 中的残留木马池保存着来自较早调用的一份标记为 hr 的工资表。 当后续调用向声明的目标 ocr.example（该目标已获准处理 finance 数据）发送一份标记为 finance 的发票时，隐藏例程会附加这份工资表。 签名有效，目标被允许，且回复携带发票的标签，然而工资表却到达了一个未获准处理它的主机；每次调用使用全新进程即可清除该藏匿内容。

sents.en: The first failure mode is cross-call state .
sents.zh: 第一种失败模式是跨调用状态。

sents.en: In our running example ( Fig. 2 a–b), the carry-over Trojan pool in ocr_pdf keeps a salary sheet labelled hr from an earlier call.
sents.zh: 在我们的运行示例（图 2 a–b）中，ocr_pdf 中的残留木马池保存着来自较早调用的一份标记为 hr 的工资表。

sents.en: When a later call sends an invoice labelled finance to the declared destination ocr.example , which is cleared for finance data, the hidden routine appends the salary sheet.
sents.zh: 当后续调用向声明的目标 ocr.example（该目标已获准处理 finance 数据）发送一份标记为 finance 的发票时，隐藏例程会附加这份工资表。

sents.en: The signature is valid, the destination is allowed and the reply carries the invoice’s label, yet the salary sheet reaches a host not cleared for it; a fresh process per call would remove the stash.
sents.zh: 签名有效，目标被允许，且回复携带发票的标签，然而工资表却到达了一个未获准处理它的主机；每次调用使用全新进程即可清除该藏匿内容。

paragraphs.en: The second failure mode is within-call mixing . A call to ocr_annotate ( Fig. 2 c) holds the invoice and, as a reference, the salary sheet; the agent is cleared for both, ocr.example only for the invoice. A hidden routine that copies the salary sheet into the OCR request needs no state, so neither a fresh process nor a per-call policy separates the two items. smuggle is a variant in which the extra data comes from the tool’s permitted read set rather than from the call’s items.
paragraphs.zh: 第二种失效模式是调用内混合。 对 ocr_annotate 的调用（图 2c）同时携带发票以及作为参考的工资表；该智能体对两者均有权限，而 ocr.example 仅对发票有权限。 一个将工资表复制进 OCR 请求的隐藏例程不需要任何状态，因此无论是新进程还是按调用的策略都无法把这两项区分开。smuggle 是一种变体，其中额外的数据来自该工具被允许读取的集合，而不是来自调用本身的项目。

sents.en: The second failure mode is within-call mixing .
sents.zh: 第二种失效模式是调用内混合。

sents.en: A call to ocr_annotate ( Fig. 2 c) holds the invoice and, as a reference, the salary sheet; the agent is cleared for both, ocr.example only for the invoice.
sents.zh: 对 ocr_annotate 的调用（图 2c）同时携带发票以及作为参考的工资表；该智能体对两者均有权限，而 ocr.example 仅对发票有权限。

paragraphs.en: The closest prior design combines secure multi-execution, one execution per security level [ 14 ] (also proposed for language models [ 20 ] ), with request-reset isolation [ 15 ] and agent IFC [ 11 , 12 ] , and addresses both failure modes in principle. Against an adversarial signed release it would still need four elements: a germline checked to be data-free before every fork despite the release’s own initialisation code; grouping by declared destinations fixed before any content is read; horizon-keyed state slots whose labels cover stored state; and witnesses that a third party can verify by re-running the signed release. Grouping by contacted hosts instead discloses one bit per call ( Lemma 2 ). Section VIII gives the full comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的先行设计将安全多执行（每个安全级别执行一次 [14]，也被提出用于语言模型 [20]）与请求重置隔离 [15] 和智能体信息流控制 [11, 12] 相结合，并在原则上应对了两种失效模式。 面对对抗性的签名发布，它仍需要四个要素：尽管发布自带初始化代码，但在每次分叉前都检查为无数据的种系；在任何内容被读取之前按预先固定的声明目的地进行分组；其标签覆盖已存储状态的以水平线为键的状态槽；以及第三方可通过重新运行该签名发布来验证的见证。 而按被联系的主机分组则会每次调用泄露一个比特（引理 2）。 第 VIII 节给出了完整比较。

sents.en: The closest prior design combines secure multi-execution, one execution per security level [ 14 ] (also proposed for language models [ 20 ] ), with request-reset isolation [ 15 ] and agent IFC [ 11 , 12 ] , and addresses both failure modes in principle.
sents.zh: 最接近的先行设计将安全多执行（每个安全级别执行一次 [14]，也被提出用于语言模型 [20]）与请求重置隔离 [15] 和智能体信息流控制 [11, 12] 相结合，并在原则上应对了两种失效模式。

sents.en: Against an adversarial signed release it would still need four elements: a germline checked to be data-free before every fork despite the release’s own initialisation code; grouping by declared destinations fixed before any content is read; horizon-keyed state slots whose labels cover stored state; and witnesses that a third party can verify by re-running the signed release.
sents.zh: 面对对抗性的签名发布，它仍需要四个要素：尽管发布自带初始化代码，但在每次分叉前都检查为无数据的种系；在任何内容被读取之前按预先固定的声明目的地进行分组；其标签覆盖已存储状态的以水平线为键的状态槽；以及第三方可通过重新运行该签名发布来验证的见证。

sents.en: Grouping by contacted hosts instead discloses one bit per call ( Lemma 2 ).
sents.zh: 而按被联系的主机分组则会每次调用泄露一个比特（引理 2）。

sents.en: Section VIII gives the full comparison.
sents.zh: 第 VIII 节给出了完整比较。

paragraphs.en: An agent invokes third-party MCP tools on a machine holding labelled data, such as HR records and invoices. Each call receives labelled items, may contact the destinations ( Section II-B ) its function declares in the signed manifest, and returns a result to consumers such as the agent, a mail recipient or a public post. An item may reach a destination or consumer only if its clearance covers the item’s label.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在持有标注数据（如人事记录和发票）的机器上调用第三方 MCP 工具。 每次调用会接收标注条目，可以联系其函数在已签名清单中声明的目的地（第 II-B 节），并向诸如智能体、邮件收件人或公开发帖等消费者返回结果。 只有当消费者的许可级别覆盖条目的标签时，条目才能到达该目的地或消费者。

sents.en: An agent invokes third-party MCP tools on a machine holding labelled data, such as HR records and invoices.
sents.zh: 智能体在持有标注数据（如人事记录和发票）的机器上调用第三方 MCP 工具。

sents.en: Each call receives labelled items, may contact the destinations ( Section II-B ) its function declares in the signed manifest, and returns a result to consumers such as the agent, a mail recipient or a public post.
sents.zh: 每次调用会接收标注条目，可以联系其函数在已签名清单中声明的目的地（第 II-B 节），并向诸如智能体、邮件收件人或公开发帖等消费者返回结果。

sents.en: An item may reach a destination or consumer only if its clearance covers the item’s label.
sents.zh: 只有当消费者的许可级别覆盖条目的标签时，条目才能到达该目的地或消费者。

paragraphs.en: The adversary controls the whole signed release: its code, manifest, initialisation code and dependencies, and any number of updates, which may be obfuscated or contain dormant or content-triggered logic. Every release is validly signed by the pinned publisher key and performs its advertised function, so signature checks and functional tests pass. The adversary knows our mechanism, may target it from initialisation code, and may control colluding releases, some input contents and any destination; we do not rely on the agent’s model to choose tools or recipients correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 攻击者控制整个已签名的发布版本：其代码、清单、初始化代码和依赖项，以及任意数量的更新，这些更新可能经过混淆，或包含休眠的或由内容触发的逻辑。 每个发布版本都由固定的发布者密钥有效签名，并执行其宣称的功能，因此签名检查和功能测试都能通过。 攻击者了解我们的机制，可能从初始化代码针对它，并可能控制合谋的发布版本、部分输入内容和任意目的地；我们不依赖智能体的模型来正确选择工具或接收方。

sents.en: The adversary controls the whole signed release: its code, manifest, initialisation code and dependencies, and any number of updates, which may be obfuscated or contain dormant or content-triggered logic.
sents.zh: 攻击者控制整个已签名的发布版本：其代码、清单、初始化代码和依赖项，以及任意数量的更新，这些更新可能经过混淆，或包含休眠的或由内容触发的逻辑。

sents.en: Every release is validly signed by the pinned publisher key and performs its advertised function, so signature checks and functional tests pass.
sents.zh: 每个发布版本都由固定的发布者密钥有效签名，并执行其宣称的功能，因此签名检查和功能测试都能通过。

sents.en: The adversary knows our mechanism, may target it from initialisation code, and may control colluding releases, some input contents and any destination; we do not rely on the agent’s model to choose tools or recipients correctly.
sents.zh: 攻击者了解我们的机制，可能从初始化代码针对它，并可能控制合谋的发布版本、部分输入内容和任意目的地；我们不依赖智能体的模型来正确选择工具或接收方。

paragraphs.en: Labels and clearances come from the deployer’s policy, not from the release. The declared destinations of each function and an optional determinism declaration come from the signed manifest; the adversary chooses them, so they affect how many copies run and how much weight a divergence carries, but never what a destination may receive. Call metadata (function name, arguments, item names and labels) is public and trusted for routing only, while secret content travels as a labelled item ( A5 ). The trusted computing base is the kernel, the broker that mediates every request a tool sends, the policy and signature verification; Section V-B states assumptions A1 – A6 , which also exclude timing channels.
paragraphs.zh: 标签与许可来自部署者的策略，而非来自发布物。 每个函数声明的目的地以及可选的确定性声明来自签名清单；这些内容由攻击者选择，因此它们会影响运行的副本数量以及一次偏差所承载的权重，但绝不会影响某个目的地可以接收什么。 调用元数据（函数名、参数、条目名称和标签）是公开的，且仅用于路由目的被视为可信，而机密内容以带标签的条目形式传输（A5）。 可信计算基包括内核、中介每个工具所发送请求的代理（broker）、策略与签名验证；第 V-B 节陈述了假设 A1–A6，这些假设同样排除了时序信道。

sents.en: Labels and clearances come from the deployer’s policy, not from the release.
sents.zh: 标签与许可来自部署者的策略，而非来自发布物。

sents.en: The trusted computing base is the kernel, the broker that mediates every request a tool sends, the policy and signature verification; Section V-B states assumptions A1 – A6 , which also exclude timing channels.
sents.zh: 可信计算基包括内核、中介每个工具所发送请求的代理（broker）、策略与签名验证；第 V-B 节陈述了假设 A1–A6，这些假设同样排除了时序信道。

paragraphs.en: A tool call is shaped by four inputs, and any of them may be adversarial. The primary vector, V1 , is the tool code itself: hidden functionality in a signed release, introduced during development, by an authenticated update or by a compromised dependency, as in the xz backdoor [ 5 ] ; our corpus includes a release whose only change is such a dependency bump ( dep ). V1 code can realise both failure modes of Section II-C , and Section VII-C measures V1 alone and in each composition ( Fig. 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 工具调用由四个输入构成，其中任何一个都可能是对抗性的。 主要攻击向量 V1 是工具代码本身：即在已签名的发布版本、开发过程中、经身份验证的更新或被入侵的依赖中隐藏的功能，如 xz 后门 [ 5 ] ；我们的语料库包含一个发布版本，其唯一改动就是这样一次依赖升级（ dep ）。 V1 代码可以实现第 II-C 节的两种失效模式，第 VII-C 节分别测量了 V1 单独使用以及与其他方式组合使用的情况（ 图 3 ）。

sents.en: A tool call is shaped by four inputs, and any of them may be adversarial.
sents.zh: 工具调用由四个输入构成，其中任何一个都可能是对抗性的。

sents.en: The primary vector, V1 , is the tool code itself: hidden functionality in a signed release, introduced during development, by an authenticated update or by a compromised dependency, as in the xz backdoor [ 5 ] ; our corpus includes a release whose only change is such a dependency bump ( dep ).
sents.zh: 主要攻击向量 V1 是工具代码本身：即在已签名的发布版本、开发过程中、经身份验证的更新或被入侵的依赖中隐藏的功能，如 xz 后门 [ 5 ] ；我们的语料库包含一个发布版本，其唯一改动就是这样一次依赖升级（ dep ）。

sents.en: V1 code can realise both failure modes of Section II-C , and Section VII-C measures V1 alone and in each composition ( Fig. 3 ).
sents.zh: V1 代码可以实现第 II-C 节的两种失效模式，第 VII-C 节分别测量了 V1 单独使用以及与其他方式组合使用的情况（ 图 3 ）。

paragraphs.en: Table II covers the other vectors, each with a compositional attack from our corpus whose parts are harmless alone but disclose data together. All reduce to one data-flow question: does a request or a returned value carry an item to a sink not cleared for it? The guarantees for V1 therefore cover the data flows of V2 and V3 ; for V4 we supply the labels that CaMeL [ 12 ] and FIDES [ 11 ] consume, while prompt injection without hidden code remains their task.
paragraphs.zh: 表II涵盖了其余向量，每个向量都对应我们语料库中的一次组合攻击，其各部分单独来看并无危害，但合在一起便会泄露数据。 所有这些都可以归结为一个数据流问题：请求或返回值是否将某个数据项带到了未经其许可的汇点？ 因此，针对V1的保证涵盖了V2和V3的数据流；对于V4，我们提供了CaMeL[12]和FIDES[11]所使用的标签，而不含隐藏代码的提示注入仍由它们负责处理。

sents.en: Table II covers the other vectors, each with a compositional attack from our corpus whose parts are harmless alone but disclose data together.
sents.zh: 表II涵盖了其余向量，每个向量都对应我们语料库中的一次组合攻击，其各部分单独来看并无危害，但合在一起便会泄露数据。

sents.en: All reduce to one data-flow question: does a request or a returned value carry an item to a sink not cleared for it?
sents.zh: 所有这些都可以归结为一个数据流问题：请求或返回值是否将某个数据项带到了未经其许可的汇点？

sents.en: The guarantees for V1 therefore cover the data flows of V2 and V3 ; for V4 we supply the labels that CaMeL [ 12 ] and FIDES [ 11 ] consume, while prompt injection without hidden code remains their task.
sents.zh: 因此，针对V1的保证涵盖了V2和V3的数据流；对于V4，我们提供了CaMeL[12]和FIDES[11]所使用的标签，而不含隐藏代码的提示注入仍由它们负责处理。

paragraphs.en: We focus on disclosure because it is the harm that signature pinning, MCPGuard’s egress control [ 10 ] and CaMeL/FIDES-style labels are built to stop. Other payload types are out of scope, harmful commands to a permitted destination are a stated boundary, and action control remains a composable layer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们关注泄露问题，因为它是签名固定、MCPGuard 的出口控制 [ 10 ] 以及 CaMeL/FIDES 式标签机制所要阻止的危害。 其他载荷类型不在范围内，向被允许的目的地发送有害命令是一个明确的边界，而动作控制则仍是一个可组合的层级。

sents.en: We focus on disclosure because it is the harm that signature pinning, MCPGuard’s egress control [ 10 ] and CaMeL/FIDES-style labels are built to stop.
sents.zh: 我们关注泄露问题，因为它是签名固定、MCPGuard 的出口控制 [ 10 ] 以及 CaMeL/FIDES 式标签机制所要阻止的危害。

sents.en: Other payload types are out of scope, harmful commands to a permitted destination are a stated boundary, and action control remains a composable layer.
sents.zh: 其他载荷类型不在范围内，向被允许的目的地发送有害命令是一个明确的边界，而动作控制则仍是一个可组合的层级。

paragraphs.en: The problem is to run a possibly adversarial signed release so that each destination and consumer learns only what it is cleared for, while flow-compliant releases keep working at low cost. A release is flow-compliant if every request it sends satisfies the invariant of Section II-C ; otherwise it commits a flow violation ( Definition 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 问题在于运行一个可能是对抗性的签名发布，使得每个目的地和消费者只获知其被授权获知的内容，同时让符合流的发布仍能以低成本继续工作。 如果一个发布所发送的每个请求都满足第 II-C 节的不变式，则该发布是符合流的；否则它就构成流违规（定义 5）。

sents.en: The problem is to run a possibly adversarial signed release so that each destination and consumer learns only what it is cleared for, while flow-compliant releases keep working at low cost.
sents.zh: 问题在于运行一个可能是对抗性的签名发布，使得每个目的地和消费者只获知其被授权获知的内容，同时让符合流的发布仍能以低成本继续工作。

sents.en: A release is flow-compliant if every request it sends satisfies the invariant of Section II-C ; otherwise it commits a flow violation ( Definition 5 ).
sents.zh: 如果一个发布所发送的每个请求都满足第 II-C 节的不变式，则该发布是符合流的；否则它就构成流违规（定义 5）。

paragraphs.en: R1 Prevention. The defence must enforce the invariant of Section II-C , formalised as sink noninterference ( Definition 5 ), for arbitrary signed code and without detecting the Trojan; values returned to consumers must carry labels that cover their items, replies and stored state ( Corollary 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: R1 防御。 防御必须对任意签名代码执行第 II-C 节的不变量（形式化为汇点非干扰性（定义 5）），而无需检测木马；返回给消费者的值必须带有覆盖其条目、回复和存储状态的标签（推论 2）。

sents.en: R1 Prevention.
sents.zh: R1 防御。

sents.en: The defence must enforce the invariant of Section II-C , formalised as sink noninterference ( Definition 5 ), for arbitrary signed code and without detecting the Trojan; values returned to consumers must carry labels that cover their items, replies and stored state ( Corollary 2 ).
sents.zh: 防御必须对任意签名代码执行第 II-C 节的不变量（形式化为汇点非干扰性（定义 5）），而无需检测木马；返回给消费者的值必须带有覆盖其条目、回复和存储状态的标签（推论 2）。

paragraphs.en: R2 Evidence. For releases the broker hosts, requests that differ with and without uncleared items yield a trigger that probe replay classifies; a resulting witness can be checked by a third party by re-running the signed release, proves a flow violation, and is never false for tools deterministic within the replay model.
paragraphs.zh: R2 证据。 对于智能体所托管的发布，包含与不包含未清除项的请求差异会产生一个触发器，由探针重放进行分类；由此得到的见证可以由第三方通过重新运行已签名的发布来验证，能证明一次流程违规，并且对于在重放模型内确定性的工具而言永远不会是误报。

sents.en: R2 Evidence.
sents.zh: R2 证据。

sents.en: For releases the broker hosts, requests that differ with and without uncleared items yield a trigger that probe replay classifies; a resulting witness can be checked by a third party by re-running the signed release, proves a flow violation, and is never false for tools deterministic within the replay model.
sents.zh: 对于智能体所托管的发布，包含与不包含未清除项的请求差异会产生一个触发器，由探针重放进行分类；由此得到的见证可以由第三方通过重新运行已签名的发布来验证，能证明一次流程违规，并且对于在重放模型内确定性的工具而言永远不会是误报。

paragraphs.en: R3 Transparency and cost. A flow-compliant release must produce the same results as without the defence ( Definition 7 ), with the fewest isolated executions per call within its class ( Theorem 3 ) and per-call latency small relative to an LLM-driven episode.
paragraphs.zh: R3 透明性与成本。 符合流程的释放必须产生与无防御时相同的结果（定义 7），在其类别内每次调用的隔离执行次数最少（定理 3），且每次调用的延迟相对于由大语言模型驱动的会话而言较小。

sents.en: R3 Transparency and cost.
sents.zh: R3 透明性与成本。

sents.en: A flow-compliant release must produce the same results as without the defence ( Definition 7 ), with the fewest isolated executions per call within its class ( Theorem 3 ) and per-call latency small relative to an LLM-driven episode.
sents.zh: 符合流程的释放必须产生与无防御时相同的结果（定义 7），在其类别内每次调用的隔离执行次数最少（定理 3），且每次调用的延迟相对于由大语言模型驱动的会话而言较小。

paragraphs.en: Germline execution enforces the invariant of Section II-C from outside the tool: instead of recognising hidden code, it arranges each call so that the only execution able to reach a destination never received the items that host may not see. As in Weismann’s germ-plasm theory [ 21 ] , nothing an execution acquires flows back to the process from which later executions start. At install time, the agent platform verifies the signature and starts the release in a germline , a confined process that loads the code and runs its initialisation but never receives user data. For each call, Plan decides which items each execution holds, and the germline forks one sandboxed copy per Plan group ( Fig. 2 c). A trusted broker delivers each request only from the copy that serves its destination and compares the other copies’ requests with it.
paragraphs.zh: 种系执行从工具外部强制执行第 II-C 节的不变量：它不识别隐藏代码，而是安排每次调用，使得唯一能够到达目的地的执行从未接收过宿主不可见的条目。 正如魏斯曼的种质理论 [ 21 ]，任何执行所获得的东西都不会回流到后续执行所起点的过程。 在安装时，智能体平台验证签名，并在种系中启动该发布版本，种系是一个受限进程，它加载代码并运行其初始化，但从不接收用户数据。 对于每次调用，Plan 决定每个执行持有哪些条目，种系为每个 Plan 组派生一个沙箱副本（图 2 c）。 一个受信任的代理仅从服务于其目的地的副本处传递每个请求，并将其他副本的请求与之进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Plan reads metadata, labels, clearances, D f D_{f} and C C , never item contents. It groups the destinations and consumers in D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C by view, then splits any group whose destinations differ in clearance, so that every reply a copy receives is cleared for all members of its group. A consumer joins a group of its view whose host clearances all lie inside its own, or else gets a group of its own. Groups run smallest view first, so the requests delivered from every smaller view are recorded before a copy holding more items runs. In Fig. 2 c, ocr.example is cleared for the invoice’s finance label and the agent also for the salary sheet’s hr , so Plan forms two groups; in most calls of our workloads all members fall into one group, and the call needs a single copy.

paragraphs.en: Splitting on declared rather than contacted hosts is essential: under lazy splitting, the copy holding uncleared items decides whether d d receives any request, which discloses one bit per call and host ( Lemma 2 , Section VII-E ). With declared-destination splitting, which copies exist never depends on secret data, and within that class Plan uses the fewest copies ( Theorem 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 按声明的宿主而非实际联系的宿主进行拆分至关重要：在惰性拆分下，持有未清除项的副本决定 d d 是否会收到任何请求，这会在每次调用中泄露每个宿主的一个比特（引理 2，第 VII-E 节）。 在按声明目的地拆分的情况下，存在哪些副本从不取决于机密数据，并且在该类别中 Plan 使用的副本数量最少（定理 3）。

Plan returns two groups in order: { ocr.example } \{\texttt{ocr.example}\} with view { invoice } \{\text{invoice}\} and horizon finance , then { agent } \{\text{agent}\} with view { invoice , salary sheet } \{\text{invoice},\text{salary sheet}\} and horizon { ​ f ​ i ​ n ​ a ​ n ​ c ​ e , ​ h ​ r } \{\emph{finance},\emph{hr}\} . The broker delivers its request to ocr.example , records it with the reply as the first request to that host, and returns the reply. paragraphs.en: Copy 2 is forked next and receives both items and the slot of its own horizon. Its requests to ocr.example are never delivered; the broker compares its k k -th request to that host with the k k -th request delivered for copy 1. If they are equal, the broker replays the recorded reply, which is admissible because ocr.example is cleared only for finance; if they differ, or copy 2 sends more or fewer requests, it records a trigger and answers with the placeholder ⊥ \bot . Copy 2 returns its value to the agent, labelled with the join of its view’s labels, the clearances of hosts whose replies reached it and its slot’s label, and is killed. Offline, probe replay checks whether a trigger stems from the salary sheet ( Section IV-F ).
paragraphs.zh: 接下来 fork 出副本 2，并接收其自身视界的条目与槽位。 它对 ocr.example 的请求永远不会被投递；broker 将其发往该主机的第 k k 个请求与为副本 1 投递的第 k k 个请求进行比较。 如果二者相等，broker 会重放记录的回复，由于 ocr.example 仅为 finance 清空，这是可允许的；如果二者不同，或副本 2 发送的请求数量或多或少，broker 会记录一个触发器，并以占位符 ⊥ \bot 作答。 副本 2 将其值返回给智能体，并标以其视图的标签的连接、其收到回复的主机的许可，以及其槽位的标签，随后被终止。 离线时，探针重放检查某个触发器是否源自工资表（ Section IV-F ）。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 gives the procedure. Before every fork, the broker checks that the germline is still data-free: it has a single thread ( G1 ), no descriptor except its control socket, /dev/null streams and read-only allowed files ( G2 ), and no shared writable mapping ( G3 ); otherwise an inherited pipe or mapping could carry bytes between copies, so a release that fails a check is refused. Copies run one at a time, smallest view first, which reduces the parallel-copy timing channel we measured ( Section IX-B ). A copy that exceeds its time budget is killed and its consumers receive an error, so it cannot suppress later groups or delay destinations served by earlier copies; only groups with equal or incomparable views may wait up to the budget, which is timing ( A1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 给出了该流程。 在每次 fork 之前，broker 会检查 germline 仍然不含数据：它只有一个线程（ G1 ），除其控制套接字、/dev/null 流和只读的允许文件外没有其他描述符（ G2 ），并且没有共享的可写映射（ G3 ）；否则继承的管道或映射可能在副本之间传递字节，因此未通过检查的发布会被拒绝。 副本一次运行一个，按视图从小到大的顺序进行，这减少了我们测量到的并行副本的时序信道（ 第 IX-B 节 ）。 超出其时间预算的副本会被终止，其消费者会收到错误，因此它无法抑制后续组或延迟由更早副本服务的目的地；只有视图相等或不可比较的组才可能等待至多一个预算的时间，这是时序上的（ A1 ）。

sents.en: Algorithm 1 gives the procedure.
sents.zh: 算法 1 给出了该流程。

paragraphs.en: A request thus reaches a destination only from the copy of that destination’s group. Hidden code that adds uncleared items to a request either runs in a copy that has nothing to add or produces a request that is never delivered; in a call with several copies, that request, or an extra, missing, repeated or reordered one, is recorded as a trigger ( Theorem 2 (c)) at the cost of one digest comparison per request.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，请求只会从该目标群组的副本到达该目标。 向请求中添加未清除项的隐藏代码，要么运行在没有内容可添加的副本中，要么产生的请求永远不会被投递；在包含多个副本的调用中，该请求，或多出的、缺失的、重复的或乱序的请求，会被记录为触发器（定理 2 (c)），代价是每个请求进行一次摘要比较。

sents.en: A request thus reaches a destination only from the copy of that destination’s group.
sents.zh: 因此，请求只会从该目标群组的副本到达该目标。

sents.en: Hidden code that adds uncleared items to a request either runs in a copy that has nothing to add or produces a request that is never delivered; in a call with several copies, that request, or an extra, missing, repeated or reordered one, is recorded as a trigger ( Theorem 2 (c)) at the cost of one digest comparison per request.
sents.zh: 向请求中添加未清除项的隐藏代码，要么运行在没有内容可添加的副本中，要么产生的请求永远不会被投递；在包含多个副本的调用中，该请求，或多出的、缺失的、重复的或乱序的请求，会被记录为触发器（定理 2 (c)），代价是每个请求进行一次摘要比较。

paragraphs.en: Since copies are discarded, flow-compliant tools keep state across calls, such as a session token or a cache, through the broker. A copy reads and writes only the slot σ ⁡ [ κ ] \sigma[\kappa] of its horizon, much as a browser keeps cookies per site, so state reaches a later call only if every member of the reading group is cleared for it ( Lemma 1 ). Each slot entry stores the label of everything the writing copy had seen (its view, its slot and the hosts whose replies reached it), and a copy that receives a non-empty slot joins that label into its output label. For example, if call 1 writes an HR item into the agent’s horizon slot, the entry is stored with label { ​ h ​ r } \{\emph{hr}\} ; a later public-only call with the same horizon receives the whole slot and returns its value with L = { ​ h ​ r } L=\{\emph{hr}\} , which a downstream CaMeL- or FIDES-style policy refuses to forward to a public sink ( Table VI ).
paragraphs.zh: 由于副本会被丢弃，符合流模型的工具通过中介在多次调用之间保持状态，例如会话令牌或缓存。 每个副本只读写其视野中的槽位 σ[κ]，就像浏览器按站点保存 cookie 一样，因此只有当读取组中的每个成员都获得授权时，状态才能传递给后续调用（引理 1）。 每个槽位条目存储写入副本所见过的一切内容的标签（其视野、其槽位以及其回复能到达该副本的主机），而接收到非空槽位的副本会将该标签并入其输出标签。 例如，若调用 1 将一条 HR 条目写入智能体的视野槽位，则该条目以标签 {hr} 存储；后续一个仅公开的调用若具有相同的视野，会接收整个槽位并返回其值，且 L={hr}，下游采用 CaMeL 或 FIDES 风格的策略会拒绝将其转发到公开接收端（表 VI）。

paragraphs.en: Destination hosts are stateful too: a host e e may remember anything it was cleared to receive, so its reply carries the worst-case label c ⁡ ( e ) c(e) and is admissible for a copy only if c ⁡ ( e ) c(e) lies inside the clearance of every member of the copy’s group. Replies from remote MCP servers follow the same rule, so a reply that re-emits earlier data still carries a correct label ( Corollary 2 ); such tools cannot be forked and receive prevention but no witnesses ( Section IX-B ).
paragraphs.zh: 目的主机同样是有状态的：主机 e 可能记住它曾被允许接收的任何内容，因此它的回复携带最坏情形标签 c(e)，只有当 c(e) 落在该副本所属群组每个成员的许可范围之内时，该回复才对该副本可接纳。 来自远程 MCP 服务器的回复遵循同样的规则，因此重新发出先前数据的回复仍然携带正确的标签（推论 2）；此类工具无法被分叉（fork），只会得到预防而无见证（第 IX-B 节）。

paragraphs.en: A comparison is evidence only if a flow-compliant release produces identical requests in every copy. The broker therefore fixes twin inputs for each call, chosen without looking at item contents, from which every copy derives its clocks, exposed performance counters, random generators, os.urandom and numeric-library seeds. The shim works at the Python level, so native code and the CPU cycle counter lie outside it; they affect evidence only.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当符合流程的发布在每一个副本中产生完全相同的请求时，该比较才构成证据。 因此，代理（broker）为每次调用固定孪生输入，其选取不查看条目内容，每个副本由此推导出自身的时钟、暴露的性能计数器、随机数生成器、os.urandom 以及数值库种子。 该垫片工作在 Python 层面，因此原生代码和 CPU 周期计数器处于其范围之外；它们只影响证据。

paragraphs.en: A trigger is not yet evidence, because the comparing copy may also differ from the copy g g that serves d d in its slot or its replies. The probe therefore re-runs the release with g g ’s slot, metadata, twin inputs and replies, so that it differs from g g only in the items d d may not see, and the control re-runs g g ’s exact inputs ( Definition 6 ). If the probe’s request sequence to d d differs on each of N N tries while the control never does, the result is an item witness , which, for a release deterministic within the replay model, proves a flow violation ( Theorem 2 ). A trigger that disappears in the probe is a state or response divergence ( Proposition 1 ), and a differing control marks nondeterminism beyond twin control ( Proposition 2 ; Table XIV ). A verifier holding the release and the named items can repeat probe and control offline from the witness record. A witness must be handled at the clearance of its contents; its hash authenticates the code, not the supplied context, and it is a counterexample to flow compliance, not proof of a past disclosure.
paragraphs.zh: 触发尚不是证据，因为被比较的副本也可能不同于在其槽位或其回复中服务 d d 的副本 g g。 因此，探针使用 g g 的槽位、元数据、孪生输入和回复重新运行发布版本，使其与 g g 仅在 d d 可能看不到的条目上存在差异，而对照则使用 g g 的完全相同输入重新运行（定义 6）。 如果探针向 d d 发出的请求序列在 N N 次尝试中每次都不同，而对照从未如此，则该结果即为一个条目见证，对于在重放模型内确定性的发布版本，它证明了流违规（定理 2）。 在探针中消失的触发是状态或响应分歧（命题 1），而出现差异的对照则标记超出孪生控制的不确定性（命题 2；表 XIV）。 持有发布版本和被点名条目的验证者可以从见证记录离线重复探针和对照。 见证必须按其内容的密级处理；其哈希值仅认证代码而非所提供的上下文，它是流合规性的反例，而非过去泄露的证明。

paragraphs.en: Dampening policy. Evidence feeds a local trust policy, separate from prevention, modelled on BGP route-flap damping [ 13 ] : a release’s penalty decays with a half-life of h = 50 h=50 calls to it, refused calls included, grows by w = 250 w=250 per unverified event, and suppresses the release between thresholds S = 2000 S=2000 and R = 750 R=750 . A verified witness from a release whose signed manifest declares determinism adds 2000 and suppresses it at once. No guarantee of Section V depends on these parameters; Section B-E gives the rule and its analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 抑制策略。 证据输入一项本地信任策略，该策略与预防机制相互独立，其建模基于 BGP 路由抖动抑制（route-flap damping）[ 13 ]：某版本的罚分每次调用（包括被拒绝的调用）后按半衰期 h = 50 h=50 衰减，每个未验证事件增加 w = 250 w=250，并在阈值 S = 2000 S=2000 与 R = 750 R=750 之间抑制该版本。 来自某版本的已验证见证者，若该版本的已签名清单声明了确定性，则增加 2000 分并立即抑制该版本。 第 V 节的任何保证都不依赖于这些参数；第 B-E 节给出该规则及其分析。

paragraphs.en: Against the adversary of Section III-A , the theorems rely on six assumptions, enforced as listed in Table XIII .
paragraphs.zh: 针对第III-A节中的对手，这些定理依赖六个假设，其强制执行方式如表XIII所列。

paragraphs.en: A copy’s only external channel is its broker socket; copies run one at a time, smallest view first, each ending with its descendants before the next starts. A copy that exceeds a total time budget T T is killed, its consumers receive an error, and the other copies run as planned. Whether and how often a request is sent lies inside the model; when it is sent, including where the budget cuts a sequence, is timing and lies outside.
paragraphs.zh: 副本的唯一外部通道是它的 broker 套接字；副本一次只运行一个，视图最小的先运行，每个副本与其所有后代一起结束后，下一个才开始。 超出总时间预算 T T 的副本会被终止，其消费者会收到错误，其他副本则按计划运行。 请求是否发送以及发送的频率位于模型内部；请求何时发送，包括预算在序列中的切断位置，属于时序问题，位于模型外部。

paragraphs.en: The kernel, broker, label policy and signature verification are correct, and the broker delivers each request to its named destination only (no redirects).

paragraphs.en: A Python-level shim controls the clock, seed, os.urandom and performance counters, not the CPU cycle counter. Only Theorem 2 uses A4 .

paragraphs.en: Assume A1 – A6 ; a release is deterministic within the replay model if it draws on no source outside A4 . (a) Witness soundness: if r r is deterministic within the replay model and an item witness for ( r , d ) (r,d) exists, r r has a flow violation toward destination host d d . (b) No false item witnesses: if such a r r is flow-compliant toward d d , stateful or not, no item witness for d d is produced. (c) Detection coverage: in a call in which Plan forks more than one copy, if a copy whose view strictly contains V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) finishes within its deadline and its request sequence to d d differs from the delivered sequence in content, count or order, including a request absent from either, the tripwire records a trigger, and probe replay classifies it as an item witness, a state or response divergence ( Proposition 1 ) or nondeterminism outside A4 ( Proposition 2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 假设 A1 – A6 成立；若一次发布在重放模型内不依赖 A4 之外的任何来源，则该发布是确定性的。 (a) 见证可靠性：若 r r 在重放模型内是确定性的，且存在针对 ( r , d ) (r,d) 的条目见证，则 r r 在向目标主机 d d 的方向上存在流违规。 (b) 不产生虚假条目见证：若这样的 r r 在向 d d 的方向上是流合规的，无论其是否有状态，都不会产生针对 d d 的条目见证。 (c) 检测覆盖：在一次 Plan 分叉出多于一个副本的调用中，若某个副本的视图严格包含 V ⁡ ( d ) V(d)，并在其截止期限内完成，且其向 d d 发出的请求序列与实际送达的序列在内容、数量或顺序上存在差异（包括某一方缺失的请求），则绊线会记录一次触发，探针重放会将其归类为条目见证、状态或响应分歧（命题 1），或 A4 之外的非确定性（命题 2）。

paragraphs.en: A fork rule is data-independent if it fixes, before any run, the runs and their item sets and the rule that selects which run’s output each member of D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C receives, as a function of f f , m m , labels, clearances, D f D_{f} and C C only. A mechanism is transparent if, for every flow-compliant release, each destination host and consumer receives exactly what that release produces on its own view with admissible replies.
paragraphs.zh: 如果分叉规则在任何运行开始之前就固定了各次运行及其条目集合，以及决定 D_f ∪ C 中每个成员接收哪次运行输出的规则，且该固定仅作为 f、m、标签、许可级别、D_f 和 C 的函数，则该分叉规则是数据无关的。 如果对于每一次符合流的发布，每个目标主机和消费者恰好接收到该发布基于其自身视图并在允许的回复下所产生的内容，则该机制是透明的。

paragraphs.en: Call a mechanism black-box if it learns a release only by running it and delivers only outputs of runs on item subsets, in which other items arrive as empty names. Consider black-box mechanisms with a data-independent fork rule; releases with one manifest then receive the same runs and the same output rule. (a) Any such mechanism that satisfies Theorem 1 for every release and is transparent must, in every call, run the release on each distinct view among D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C , and within a view once per distinct clearance among its destination hosts, plus once, if there are any, for the consumers whose clearance contains no host clearance of that view. (b) Plan creates exactly these runs, so declared-destination splitting is optimal within this class.
paragraphs.zh: 若一个机制只能通过运行发布来学习信息，且只输出在条目子集上运行的结果（其中其他条目以空名称形式到达），则称该机制为黑盒机制。 考虑具有数据无关分叉规则的黑盒机制；带有单一清单的发布此时会获得相同的运行和相同的输出规则。 （a）任何对每个发布都满足定理 1 且是透明的此类机制，在每次调用中，都必须对 D_{f}∪C 中的每个不同视图运行该发布一次，且在每个视图内对其目标主机中的每个不同权限各运行一次；如果存在权限不包含该视图任何主机权限的消费者，则还要额外运行一次。 （b）计划（Plan）恰好创建这些运行，因此声明目标拆分在此类机制中是最优的。

paragraphs.en: The class matters: under lazy splitting , a fork rule that is not data-independent, d d ’s copy is forked only when the full-view copy contacts d d .
paragraphs.zh: 类很重要：在惰性分裂（lazy splitting）下，非数据无关的分叉规则中，d d 的副本仅在全视图副本接触 d d 时才会被分叉。

paragraphs.en: Under lazy splitting, whether destination host d d receives any request in a call is a function of items outside V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) , one bit per call and destination host, which the tripwire cannot see because the delivered request comes from the copy with view V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) .
paragraphs.zh: 在惰性分裂（lazy splitting）下，目标主机 $d$ 是否在调用中收到任何请求，取决于 $V(d)$ 之外的因素，即每个调用和目标主机对应一个比特，而该比特是绊线（tripwire）无法看到的，因为被投递的请求来自具有视图 $V(d)$ 的副本。

paragraphs.en: The price of a data-independent rule is that the bound counts declared rather than contacted destinations; the existence-bit test measures the bit ( Section VII-E ), and Appendix A gives the cost of a call.
paragraphs.zh: 数据无关规则的代价在于，该边界统计的是已声明的目的地而非实际联系过的目的地；存在位测试测量的是该位（第 VII-E 节），附录 A 给出了调用（call）的代价。

paragraphs.en: The Germline prototype realises Algorithm 1 on stock Linux without kernel changes, in Python 3.13. Its core has 999 lines (broker with Plan and baselines, germline fork server, confinement, witnesses, dampening); the tool host inside every copy adds 151 lines and the germline for unmodified MCP servers 75. For the comparison with MCPGuard ( Section VII-B ), the broker also runs inside MCPGuard’s own runner. A publisher Ed25519 key [ 16 ] signs TUF-style metadata [ 2 ] with each release’s version, SHA-256 hash and length; the host pins the key and verifies every release, including updates, before extracting it. The signed manifest lists readable paths, destinations and whether the release declares determinism. Other language runtimes would use snapshot-based germlines.
paragraphs.zh: Germline 原型在原生 Linux 上以 Python 3.13 实现了算法 1，无需修改内核。 其核心共 999 行（含 Plan 与基线的智能体、germline 派生服务器、隔离、见证与阻尼机制）；每份副本内的工具宿主额外增加 151 行，面向未经修改的 MCP 服务器的 germline 增加 75 行。 在与 MCPGuard 的对比中（第 VII-B 节），智能体还运行在 MCPGuard 自身的运行器内。 发布者的 Ed25519 密钥 [16] 以 TUF 风格的元数据 [2] 对每个版本的版本号、SHA-256 哈希与长度进行签名；宿主固定该密钥，并在提取包括更新在内的每个版本之前加以验证。 签名的清单列出了可读路径、目标位置，以及该版本是否声明了确定性。 其他语言的运行时将使用基于快照的 germline。

paragraphs.en: Germline and copies. The germline imports the package and runs its initialisation under a read-only Landlock ruleset [ 23 ] with standard streams bound to /dev/null , and the broker inspects it through /proc for G1 – G3 before every fork. Each copy is PID 1 of its own PID namespace, with fresh network and IPC namespaces and a further read-only Landlock layer. Its only channel is a socketpair carrying length-prefixed JSON, over which it receives the public metadata, its view’s items as memfd files, its whole horizon slot and the twin inputs. The tool host then freezes wall-clock time and datetime , replaces the monotonic clock and performance counters with a deterministic counter, and seeds random , os.urandom and numpy.random . An optional pool keeps pre-forked, data-free copies ready. For an MCP server, each copy instead continues the server’s own stdio loop on a fresh socket, over which the host speaks MCP JSON-RPC, and relays HTTP to the broker over a second socket; servers run without code changes, although git needs a read-write /dev/null ( Section VII-D ).
paragraphs.zh: 种系与副本。 种系导入该包，并在一个只读的 Landlock 规则集 [ 23 ] 下运行其初始化，标准流绑定到 /dev/null，代理在每次 fork 前通过 /proc 对其检查 G1 – G3。 每个副本都是自己 PID 命名空间中的 PID 1，拥有全新的网络与 IPC 命名空间，以及另一层只读的 Landlock 限制。 它唯一的通道是一个承载带长度前缀 JSON 的 socketpair，通过该通道它接收公开元数据、以其 memfd 文件形式呈现的自身视图条目、完整的视野槽以及孪生输入。 随后，工具宿主冻结 wall-clock time 与 datetime，用确定性计数器替换单调时钟与性能计数器，并为 random、os.urandom 和 numpy.random 设置种子。 一个可选的副本池保持预先 fork 好的、不含数据的副本随时可用。 对于 MCP 服务器，每个副本改为在一个新套接字上继续服务器自身的 stdio 循环，宿主通过该套接字进行 MCP JSON-RPC 通信，并通过第二个套接字将 HTTP 中继给代理；服务器无需修改代码即可运行，尽管 git 需要可读写的 /dev/null（第 VII-D 节）。

paragraphs.en: Broker. A copy has no network: the tool host relays its HTTP requests over the channel, and the broker issues every request itself, only for the copy that holds the destination’s view, so exactly one copy delivers each external effect. Comparison, positional replay, slot labels and probe replay follow Algorithm 1 ; the trigger fires at the first mismatch or when a copy ends with a shorter sequence. Each copy has an absolute budget of 30 s from its fork, kept on the broker’s clock, so neither the copy’s messages nor its frozen clock extend it, and the broker’s own network waits end with the budget. A copy that exceeds it, crashes or sends a malformed message is killed with its descendants, its result becomes an error, and the next call proceeds normally. The broker does not follow redirects: a 3xx reply returns to the copy as the destination host’s reply.
paragraphs.zh: 中介。 副本没有网络：工具宿主通过信道中继其 HTTP 请求，由中介亲自发出每个请求，且仅针对持有目标视图的那个副本，因此恰好有一个副本产生每个外部效果。 比较、位置重放、槽标签和探测重放遵循算法 1；触发器在首次不匹配或某个副本以更短的序列结束时触发。 每个副本自其分叉起有 30 秒的绝对预算，按中介的时钟计，因此副本的消息及其冻结时钟都不能延长该预算，而中介自身的网络等待也随预算结束。 超出预算、崩溃或发送格式错误消息的副本会与其后代一起被终止，其结果变为错误，而下一次调用正常进行。 中介不跟随重定向：3xx 回复作为目标主机的回复返回给副本。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate germline execution against signed releases that perform their advertised function while carrying hidden code, through five research questions: whether a signed tool still discloses data under MCPGuard-Dynamic and whether germline execution prevents it in the same harness (RQ1, Section VII-B ); prevention across vectors, compositions, generated variants and stateful remote tools (RQ2, Section VII-C ); utility for flow-compliant tools, unmodified servers, stateful workflows and an LLM-driven agent (RQ3, Section VII-D ); soundness and coverage of witnesses, including against adaptive releases (RQ4, Section VII-E ); and latency and memory cost (RQ5, Section VII-F ). Section B-A maps each experiment to its question and result file.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过五个研究问题来评估针对带有隐藏代码但仍执行其宣称功能的签名版本的种系执行：签名工具在 MCPGuard-Dynamic 下是否仍会泄露数据，以及种系执行在同一测试环境中能否阻止其泄露（RQ1，第 VII-B 节）；跨攻击载体、组合、生成变体和有状态远程工具的阻止效果（RQ2，第 VII-C 节）；对符合流规范的工具、未修改的服务器、有状态工作流以及一个由大语言模型驱动的智能体的实用性（RQ3，第 VII-D 节）；证据的可靠性与覆盖率，包括针对自适应版本的情况（RQ4，第 VII-E 节）；以及延迟和内存开销（RQ5，第 VII-F 节）。 第 B-A 节将每个实验映射到其对应的研究问题和结果文件。

paragraphs.en: Testbed and counts. Five MCP servers (documents, SQL, web, lint, mail) each ship a flow-compliant release 1.0.0 and signed updates with hidden code, 52 in total, implementing the 15 attack variants of Section III-B ; with two benchmark releases, all 59 signed releases verify against the pinned key and complete their advertised function. We wrote these 59 releases by hand; the generated variants below are a separate corpus. By design, the test world is one user’s home directory, small enough to check every flow: PDFs labelled hr , board , finance , projx and public, two SQLite databases, a code repository, mail drafts and credential files, each protected item carrying a fresh random canary per trial. The scripted matrix has 51 attack cases (the two cooperating xtool releases form one) in 3 trials, or 153 attack runs per runtime, plus 33 benign calls per trial; the single-harness MCPGuard comparison has 5 variants, 5 runtimes and 3 trials (75 runs), and the LLM-driven agent 7 tasks, 6 releases, 4 runtimes and 3 repetitions (504 episodes).

paragraphs.en: Disclosure oracle. Five HTTP sinks record every byte they receive, and an oracle that runs outside the runtime under test counts a disclosure when a canary, decoded from raw text, URL encoding, nested base64, hex or zero-width characters, reaches a sink whose clearance excludes its label (per recipient for mail). The tables count every detected disclosure in an attack run; a disclosure that also occurs with the flow-compliant release in the same runtime is not attributed to the tool, which concerns six Sig+Pin runs ( Fig. 3 ). Prevention under Germline is structural ( Theorem 1 holds for any encoding), whereas the measurements count detected canaries; every zero below is scoped to our corpus and this oracle.
paragraphs.zh: 披露预言机。 五个 HTTP 接收端记录它们收到的每一个字节，而在被测运行时之外运行的预言机会在以下情况计为一次披露：一个金丝雀值（以原始文本、URL 编码、嵌套 base64、十六进制或零宽字符形式解码而来）到达某个其权限级别不包含该标签的接收端（邮件按收件人计算）。 表格统计一次攻击运行中检测到的每一次披露；在同一运行时中，如果某次披露在符合流规则的释放中同样出现，则不计入该工具的责任，这涉及六次 Sig+Pin 运行（图 3）。 Germline 下的防御是结构性的（定理 1 对任何编码都成立），而测量统计的是检测到的金丝雀值；下方的每一个零都限定于我们的语料库和此预言机。

paragraphs.en: Runtimes. Sig+Pin runs one persistent process per server after signature verification and key pinning; Sig+IFC adds per-call output labels as in FIDES and CaMeL [ 11 , 12 ] ; Confined+IFC adds AgentBound/MCPGuard-class confinement [ 9 , 10 ] (network namespace, Landlock [ 23 ] allowlists, broker egress allowlist); Fresh+IFC also starts a fresh process per call; and the ablation Germline -NoSplit runs one copy per call holding all inputs. We did not integrate a snapshot/restore runtime such as Groundhog [ 15 ] : its security effect, a clean state per call without per-destination views, is what Germline -NoSplit isolates, and germline execution already gains its speed by forking a pre-initialised process, so speed claims are relative to a fresh process per call only.
paragraphs.zh: 运行时环境。 Sig+Pin 在签名验证与密钥固定之后，为每台服务器运行一个持久进程；Sig+IFC 按 FIDES 和 CaMeL 的方式增加每次调用的输出标签 [11, 12]；Confined+IFC 增加 AgentBound/MCPGuard 类别的隔离约束 [9, 10]（网络命名空间、Landlock [23] 允许列表、代理出口允许列表）；Fresh+IFC 还会为每次调用启动一个全新进程；消融变体 Germline-NoSplit 则为每次调用运行一个持有全部输入的副本。 我们没有集成诸如 Groundhog [15] 这类快照/恢复运行时：其安全效果——每次调用获得干净状态但不区分按目标划分的视图——正是 Germline-NoSplit 所隔离的内容，而且 germline 执行已经通过分叉一个预初始化的进程获得了其速度优势，因此速度方面的结论仅相对于每次调用一个全新进程而言。

paragraphs.en: MCPGuard-Dynamic. We built MCPGuard-Dynamic [ 10 ] from its public repository (commit 825fdc0a ), enabled the BPF LSM and loaded its four eBPF programs, proxy, policy format and AgentBound reproduction. Our least-privilege policies in its format cover a six-call session that summarises HR and board documents, sends an invoice to the OCR destination (cleared for finance ) and posts a press-release summary to the public blog. MCPGuard’s runner executes its seven configurations ( Table I (b)) with a positive control, a raw-socket transfer to an unlisted host. The single harness runs the two strongest, C-full and C-full-percall (per-call policy enforcement), through MCPGuard’s proxy and our runtimes through our broker, in one process with the same session, world, canaries and oracle.
paragraphs.zh: MCPGuard-Dynamic。 我们基于其公开代码仓库（提交号 825fdc0a）构建了 MCPGuard-Dynamic [10]，启用了 BPF LSM 并加载其四个 eBPF 程序、代理、策略格式以及 AgentBound 的复现。 以其格式编写的我们的最小权限策略涵盖一个包含六次调用的会话：总结人力资源与董事会文件、向 OCR 目的地发送发票（已为 finance 清除授权），并将新闻稿摘要发布到公开博客。 MCPGuard 的运行器执行其七种配置（表 I (b)），并使用一个正向对照，即向未列出的主机进行的原始套接字传输。 该单一测试框架在 MCPGuard 的代理下运行其中最强的两个配置 C-full 和 C-full-percall（每次调用的策略执行），并在同一进程中通过我们的代理服务器运行我们的运行时，三者共享相同的会话、世界、金丝雀与判定标准。

paragraphs.en: In MCPGuard’s own runner, the eBPF configurations stop the raw-socket variant direct , while pool and smuggle disclose through the authorised OCR destination under all seven configurations ( Table I (b); per-configuration rows in Table X ). In the single harness, pool is the matched result: it stashes items from the HR and board calls and adds them to the next authorised OCR request. Our own smuggle release sent nothing in this session, so its prevention is measured in the scripted matrix (9 of 15 runs disclose under Sig+Pin, 3 under Confined+IFC, none under Germline ; Table XI ); launder_text reaches no sink in MCPGuard’s runner even under C0 . Germline produces no witness here, because no copy holds carried-over data or items outside its view.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MCPGuard 自身的运行器中，eBPF 配置能直接阻止 raw-socket 变体，而 pool 和 smuggle 在全部七种配置下都能通过经授权的 OCR 目的地泄露（表 I (b)；各配置的行见表 X）。 在单一测试框架中，pool 是匹配到的结果：它暂存来自 HR 和 board 调用的条目，并将它们加入下一个经授权的 OCR 请求。 我们自己的 smuggle 泄露在本次会话中未发送任何内容，因此其防护效果是在脚本化矩阵中测得的（15 次运行中有 9 次在 Sig+Pin 下泄露，3 次在 Confined+IFC 下泄露，在 Germline 下没有泄露；表 XI）；即使在 C0 下，launder_text 在 MCPGuard 的运行器中也未到达任何汇聚点。 Germline 在此不会产生证据，因为没有副本持有超出其视野的被携带数据或条目。

paragraphs.en: Takeaway. MCPGuard confines destinations as designed, yet the signed pool release discloses through the authorised OCR destination in 3 of 3 trials under every configuration; none was detected under germline execution.
paragraphs.zh: 要点总结。 MCPGuard 按设计限制了目标，但签名池发布在所有配置下的 3 次试验中均通过经授权的 OCR 目标发生泄露；在 germline 执行下无一被检测到。

sents.en: Takeaway.
sents.zh: 要点总结。

sents.en: MCPGuard confines destinations as designed, yet the signed pool release discloses through the authorised OCR destination in 3 of 3 trials under every configuration; none was detected under germline execution.
sents.zh: MCPGuard 按设计限制了目标，但签名池发布在所有配置下的 3 次试验中均通过经授权的 OCR 目标发生泄露；在 germline 执行下无一被检测到。

paragraphs.en: This marks the boundary of destination-based confinement: MCPGuard binds authority to a process and its destinations, and its per-call mode re-applies the policy while the process and its memory persist, whereas germline execution binds authority to the items each copy may see, so the two compose ( Section IX-A ).
paragraphs.zh: 这标志着基于目的地的限制的边界：MCPGuard 将权限绑定到进程及其目的地，并且其每次调用模式会在进程及其内存持续存在期间重新应用该策略，而种系执行则将权限绑定到每个副本可能看到的项目，因此二者可以组合使用（ Section IX-A ）。

paragraphs.en: No canary disclosure was detected in 153 attack runs under Germline ( Fig. 3 ). Each baseline binds authority to a different object and so misses a different vector: output labels miss carry-over and laundering, and confinement misses disclosure through permitted destinations, content-triggered code ( V1 + V2 ) and a second server that ships what the first dropped ( V1 + V3 ). A fresh process per call removes carry-over but still mixes items within a call, and Germline -NoSplit shows that without split views one copy can place protected items in a request to a less-cleared destination. The dependency bump dep discloses under Confined+IFC but not under Germline , and the germline checks refuse the two releases that attack initialisation ( init_thread , hijack ) before their first call. Germline records 12 triggers in attack runs and none in benign runs ( Section VII-E ); per-variant disclosure counts are in Table XI .
paragraphs.zh: 在 Germline 下的 153 次攻击运行中未检测到任何金丝雀泄露（图 3）。 每个基线将权限绑定到不同的对象上，因此各自漏掉不同的攻击向量：输出标签会漏掉残留和洗白，而隔离会漏掉通过允许的目的地、内容触发的代码（V1 + V2）以及转发第一个服务器丢弃内容的第二个服务器（V1 + V3）造成的泄露。 每次调用使用全新进程可消除残留，但在单次调用内仍会混合多个条目，而 Germline -NoSplit 表明，在没有分离视图的情况下，一个副本就可以把受保护条目放入发往较低审查级别目的地的请求中。 依赖版本升级的补丁在 Confined+IFC 下会发生泄露，但在 Germline 下不会，并且 germline 检查在首次调用之前就拒绝了两个攻击初始化的发布版本（init_thread、hijack）。 Germline 在攻击运行中记录了 12 次触发，在良性运行中为零（第 VII-E 节）；各变体的泄露次数见表 XI。

sents.en: No canary disclosure was detected in 153 attack runs under Germline ( Fig. 3 ).
sents.zh: 在 Germline 下的 153 次攻击运行中未检测到任何金丝雀泄露（图 3）。

sents.en: Each baseline binds authority to a different object and so misses a different vector: output labels miss carry-over and laundering, and confinement misses disclosure through permitted destinations, content-triggered code ( V1 + V2 ) and a second server that ships what the first dropped ( V1 + V3 ).
sents.zh: 每个基线将权限绑定到不同的对象上，因此各自漏掉不同的攻击向量：输出标签会漏掉残留和洗白，而隔离会漏掉通过允许的目的地、内容触发的代码（V1 + V2）以及转发第一个服务器丢弃内容的第二个服务器（V1 + V3）造成的泄露。

sents.en: A fresh process per call removes carry-over but still mixes items within a call, and Germline -NoSplit shows that without split views one copy can place protected items in a request to a less-cleared destination.
sents.zh: 每次调用使用全新进程可消除残留，但在单次调用内仍会混合多个条目，而 Germline -NoSplit 表明，在没有分离视图的情况下，一个副本就可以把受保护条目放入发往较低审查级别目的地的请求中。

sents.zh: 依赖版本升级的补丁在 Confined+IFC 下会发生泄露，但在 Germline 下不会，并且 germline 检查在首次调用之前就拒绝了两个攻击初始化的发布版本（init_thread、hijack）。

sents.zh: Germline 在攻击运行中记录了 12 次触发，在良性运行中为零（第 VII-E 节）；各变体的泄露次数见表 XI。

paragraphs.en: Generated variants. No canary disclosure was detected for any of the 91 validated variants (20 direct, 20 allowed-request, 20 dormant, 17 triggered, 14 carry-over) in three trials. An egress-allowlist defence of the MCPGuard/AgentBound class prevents the 71 that send to an attacker-owned host and none of the 20 that send to a policy-allowed host, 71 of 91 (78%) overall; germline execution prevents those 20 at the view boundary, because the copy serving the public destination never receives the protected note, so no witnesses arise. As an author-generated corpus, it shows that prevention generalises beyond our hand-written payloads; it is not an independent benchmark and does not show how common such code is.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的变体。 在三次试验中，91 个经验证的变体（20 个直接变体、20 个允许请求变体、20 个休眠变体、17 个触发变体、14 个残留变体）均未检测到金丝雀泄露。 MCPGuard/AgentBound 类的出口允许列表防御可阻止其中发送到攻击者所拥有主机的 71 个变体，而对发送到策略允许主机的 20 个变体均无法阻止，总计 91 个中的 71 个（78%）；种系执行则可在视图边界处阻止那 20 个变体，因为服务于公共目的地的副本永远不会接收到受保护的笔记，因此不会产生见证记录。 作为一个由作者生成的语料库，它表明防御措施可推广到我们手写的载荷之外；它并非独立基准，也不能说明此类代码有多常见。

paragraphs.en: Stateful remote tools and agent labels. A stateful remote tool, which cannot be forked, discloses 2 canaries to the public sink under per-call labels and none under the worst-case reply labels Germline assigns to remote tools ( Section IV-E ), which block 3 public posts of a flow-compliant remote tool where per-call labels block 1. In CaMeL’s reference interpreter (commit f083b6b ) with its AgentDojo Workspace policy [ 12 , 24 ] , run on hand-written plans, a second reply of a stateful tool that re-emits a private email body from the first call is labelled public and passes the send_email policy to an untrusted recipient in NORMAL and STRICT modes, while sending the body directly is denied. This needs the deployer to list the stateful tool as side-effect-free, a declaration CaMeL takes on trust for exactly the trusted signed component of our threat model. No FIDES code was available to us. Under Germline , a slot-stored HR item recalled by a later public-only call returns labelled hr and is refused by a downstream policy, while a public-only control is forwarded ( Table VI ).
paragraphs.zh: 有状态的远程工具与智能体标签。 一个有状态的远程工具（无法被 fork）在按次调用标签下向公共汇（public sink）泄露 2 个 canary，而在 Germline 分配给远程工具的最坏情况回复标签下泄露 0 个（第 IV-E 节）；后者会阻止 3 个流合规远程工具的公开帖子，而按次调用标签只阻止其中 1 个。 在 CaMeL 的参考解释器（commit f083b6b）及其 AgentDojo Workspace 策略 [12, 24] 中，以手写计划运行时，某个有状态工具的第二次回复会把首次调用中的私人邮件正文重新发出，该回复被标记为 public，并通过 send_email 策略发送给不可信接收者（在 NORMAL 和 STRICT 模式下均如此）；而直接发送该正文则会被拒绝。 这需要部署者将该有状态工具列为无副作用，而 CaMeL 恰好是对我们威胁模型中受信任的签名组件才接受这种声明的信任。 我们无法获得 FIDES 的代码。 在 Germline 下，一个存储在槽（slot）中的 HR 条目被后续仅 public 的调用读取时会返回标记为 hr 的数据，并被下游策略拒绝；而仅 public 的对照数据则被放行（表 VI）。

paragraphs.en: A tool call is compatible only if its output equals that of the unprotected server, and an LLM task succeeds only if the answer contains the expected key string or the requested post was made, as checked automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当工具调用的输出与未受保护服务器的输出相同时，该工具调用才是兼容的；只有当答案包含预期的关键字符串或已发布所请求的帖子时（由自动检查验证），LLM 任务才算成功。

paragraphs.en: LLM-driven agent. Qwen3-32B-AWQ [ 25 ] chooses every tool call in seven document tasks, for the flow-compliant release and five releases with hidden code; the agent completes every task and no canary disclosure was detected under Germline ( Table IV ). With reasoning enabled (Qwen3.5-27B), launder_text disclosed under no runtime, while pool still disclosed 2 canaries under Sig+IFC and Confined+IFC and none under Germline .
paragraphs.zh: 由大语言模型驱动的智能体。 Qwen3-32B-AWQ [ 25 ] 在七个文档任务中选择了每一次工具调用，包括符合流程的发布版以及五个包含隐藏代码的发布版；该智能体完成了所有任务，并且在 Germline 下未检测到任何金丝雀泄露（表 IV）。 在启用推理（Qwen3.5-27B）的情况下，launder_text 在任何运行时下均未泄露，而 pool 在 Sig+IFC 和 Confined+IFC 下仍泄露了 2 个金丝雀，在 Germline 下则没有泄露。

sents.zh: 由大语言模型驱动的智能体。

paragraphs.en: Unmodified servers and workflows. We called four unmodified official MCP servers [ 1 ] 780 times under Germline : the two tools of mcp-server-time and the fetch tool of mcp-server-fetch 200 times each, and three tools each of mcp-server-sqlite and mcp-server-git 30 times each. Every call returned the same output as the unprotected server, apart from the clock value of get_current_time , while median per-call latency rose from 1.2–18.4 ms to 39.0–110.3 ms ( Appendix B ). The fetch tool’s destination was declared per call from its URL ( A5 ). Two workflows also behave identically, with no witness: a notes tool that keeps its notes through the broker’s slot interface, rather than in process memory, adds two notes and shows them; and a call that sends an invoice ( finance ) to the OCR host and returns a payslip ( hr ) only to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 未修改的服务器与工作流。 我们在 Germline 下对四个未修改的官方 MCP 服务器调用了 [1] 780 次：mcp-server-time 的两个工具和 mcp-server-fetch 的 fetch 工具各调用 200 次，mcp-server-sqlite 和 mcp-server-git 的各三个工具各调用 30 次。 除 get_current_time 的时钟值外，每次调用都返回与未受保护服务器相同的输出，而每次调用的中位延迟从 1.2–18.4 ms 升至 39.0–110.3 ms（附录 B）。 fetch 工具的目标是每次调用时根据其 URL 声明的（A5）。 另有两个工作流行为完全相同，且无见证者：一个通过代理的槽接口而非进程内存保存笔记的笔记工具，添加两条笔记并显示它们；以及一个将发票（finance）发送到 OCR 主机、而仅向智能体返回工资单（hr）的调用。

paragraphs.en: We test the three parts of Theorem 2 , each against its reference where one exists ( Tables XII , V and VI ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们对定理 2 的三个部分分别进行测试，每一部分在存在参照的情况下与其参照进行对比（表 XII、V 和 VI）。

paragraphs.en: Verified witnesses. Germline raised 12 triggers in the scripted matrix, one per trial for four document-server releases. The triggers of pool , launder and evasive reproduce in every probe while the control stays constant, so each yields an item witness and, by Theorem 2 (a), a verified flow violation. The capsule trigger vanishes with the destination’s slot, a state divergence ( Proposition 1 ); its disclosure was prevented. A witness occupies 7,450 bytes and verifies in about 0.35 s, off the agent’s critical path.
paragraphs.zh: 已验证的见证。 Germline 在脚本化矩阵中触发了 12 次触发器，针对四个文档服务器版本，每次试验各一次。 pool、launder 和 evasive 的触发器在每次探测中都会复现，而对照组保持不变，因此每个都产生一个条目见证，并依据定理 2 (a) 产生一个已验证的流违规。 capsule 触发器随目的地的槽位而消失，这是一种状态分歧（命题 1）；其泄露已被阻止。 一个见证占用 7,450 字节，验证耗时约 0.35 秒，且不在智能体的关键路径上。

paragraphs.en: Detection coverage. Four fixtures exercise Theorem 2 (c): the copy holding an uncleared item adds a request, omits one, duplicates one, or reorders two. Each raises one trigger that probe replay verifies as an item witness, and none fires with sequence comparison switched off; a flow-compliant tool that repeats an identical request raises no trigger.
paragraphs.zh: 检测覆盖范围。 四个测试用例验证定理 2 (c)：持有未清除项的副本增加一个请求、省略一个请求、重复一个请求或对两个请求重新排序。 每个用例都会引发一个触发器，探针重放将其验证为项见证；在关闭序列比较时则均不会触发；一个符合流程的工具重复发出完全相同的请求不会引发触发器。

sents.zh: 检测覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: Existence bit. To test Lemma 2 , a release sends the cleared invoice to the OCR host in call i i only if bit i i of a 64-bit secret is one (23 ones); a copy that cannot see the secret falls back to sending or to not sending. With the sending fallback, lazy splitting lets the host recover all 64 bits (0.942 bits per call) without a trigger; with the other, it recovers 41 bits, no more than always guessing zero. Declared-destination splitting discloses 0.000 bits in both settings, and its tripwire fires on every secret-dependent attempt (23/23 added and 41/41 omitted requests).
paragraphs.zh: 存在位。 为验证引理 2，释放操作仅在 64 位秘密的第 i 位为 1（共 23 个 1）时，才在第 i 次调用中将已清除的发票发送给 OCR 主机；无法看到该秘密的副本则回退为发送或不发送。 在“发送”回退方案下，惰性拆分使主机无需触发器即可恢复全部 64 位（每次调用 0.942 位）；在“不发送”回退方案下，主机最多恢复 41 位，不会超过总是猜测为零的结果。 声明目的地的拆分在两种设置下均泄露 0.000 位，并且其绊线在每一次依赖秘密的尝试中都会触发（23 个新增请求全部触发，41 个被省略的请求全部触发）。

paragraphs.en: Deniability, pre-deployment checks and dampening. Six variants that add noise from os.urandom , the performance counter or the clock disclosed no HR content, and their secret-dependent triggers verified in 20 of 20 calls. Of the 52 signed releases with hidden code, a static scan flags only 1 after obfuscation, and a three-call honey test flags 28, missing releases of dormant , trigger , pool and smuggle among others. Dampening suppresses an always-diverging release after 9 calls; in simulation, random unexplained divergence on 3% of calls causes false suppression within 10,000 calls with probability 2.4%, and at 1% none within 100,000 calls, while bursty divergence is suppressed more often ( Fig. 4 (d), Section B-E ).
paragraphs.zh: 可否认性、部署前检查与抑制机制。 从 os.urandom、性能计数器或时钟添加噪声的六个变体均未泄露任何高风险（HR）内容，其依赖秘密的触发器在 20 次调用中的 20 次均得到验证。 在 52 个包含隐藏代码的签名发布中，静态扫描在混淆后仅标记出 1 个，而三次调用的蜜罐测试仅标记出 28 个，遗漏了休眠（dormant）、触发器（trigger）、池（pool）和走私（smuggle）等类型的发布。 抑制机制在 9 次调用后抑制了一个始终发散的发布；在仿真中，3% 的调用出现随机无法解释的发散时，在 10,000 次调用内发生误抑制的概率为 2.4%，而在 1% 时 100,000 次调用内没有发生误抑制，而爆发式发散则更常被抑制（图 4(d)，B-E 节）。

paragraphs.en: Per-call latency. A call served by one copy takes 10–49 ms, 2–28 × \times faster than a fresh process per call ( Table VII , Fig. 4 (a)); for summarisation, most of the added time is the PDF parse repeated inside the copy. P99 stays within 7 ms of P50, and a pool of pre-forked copies saves a further 7–9 ms.
paragraphs.zh: 每次调用的延迟。 由一个副本服务的调用耗时 10–49 毫秒，比每次调用都启动新进程快 2–28 × \times 倍（表 VII、图 4 (a)）；对于摘要任务，增加的时间大部分是副本内部重复进行的 PDF 解析。 P99 与 P50 的差距保持在 7 毫秒以内，而预 fork 的副本池可再节省 7–9 毫秒。

sents.en: Per-call latency.
sents.zh: 每次调用的延迟。
