sents.zh: P99 与 P50 的差距保持在 7 毫秒以内，而预 fork 的副本池可再节省 7–9 毫秒。

paragraphs.en: Multiple copies and scaling. Copies run in sequence, so a call pays for every copy it needs: summarize_many runs three copies in 97.3 ms, barely faster than a fresh process (102.8 ms), and latency grows linearly with copies ( Fig. 4 (b)); external effects are never duplicated. In the 33 calls of the benign session of our scripted matrix, 31 need one copy and 2 need two; extra copies arise only when a call’s destinations or consumers differ in view or clearance, so these counts reflect our workload rather than deployed sessions. Sequential copies also reduce a timing channel between copies from 37.9–47.7 bit/s to at most 0.61 bit/s [ 26 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 多副本与扩展性。 副本按顺序运行，因此一次调用会为其所需的每个副本付出代价：summarize_many 运行三个副本耗时 97.3 毫秒，仅略快于全新进程（102.8 毫秒），且延迟随副本数量线性增长（图 4 (b)）；外部效应绝不会重复执行。 在我们脚本化矩阵良性会话的 33 次调用中，31 次需要一个副本，2 次需要两个；额外副本仅在调用的目标或消费者的视图或权限（clearance）不同时才会出现，因此这些计数反映的是我们的工作负载而非已部署的会话。 顺序副本还将副本之间的计时信道从 37.9–47.7 比特/秒降低至最多 0.61 比特/秒 [26]。

paragraphs.en: Memory and end-to-end time. A live copy adds 20 MB PSS (0.98 MB private) to a 35 MB germline, and each resident germline about 12 MB ( Fig. 4 (c)). The median LLM-driven episode took 2.04 s under Germline and 1.81–1.97 s under the baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 内存与端到端时间。 在 35 MB 的 germline 基础上，一个活跃副本增加 20 MB PSS（0.98 MB 私有内存），而每个驻留的 germline 约为 12 MB（图 4 (c)）。 在 Germline 下，LLM 驱动的回合中位耗时为 2.04 秒，而在各基线下为 1.81–1.97 秒。

paragraphs.en: Attacks, supply chain, confinement and action control. Beyond the attacks of Section I [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] , skills deviate from declared capabilities [ 17 ] , MCP servers contain risky bidirectional flows [ 18 ] , and tool poisoning [ 28 ] and parser exploits [ 29 ] add entry points. TUF [ 2 ] , in-toto [ 30 ] and Sigstore [ 3 ] authenticate who published an artefact and how it was built, which can cover hidden code [ 5 , 31 ] . AgentBound [ 9 ] and MCPGuard-Dynamic [ 10 ] build on privilege separation [ 32 , 33 ] , capabilities [ 34 ] and sandboxing [ 23 ] to bind authority to a process and its destinations. Attestation [ 27 ] , provenance binding [ 35 ] , trace checks [ 36 ] , transactional staging [ 37 ] , action validation [ 38 ] and action logs [ 39 , 40 ] decide whether an action may happen, not which items it carries.
paragraphs.zh: 攻击、供应链、隔离与行动控制。 除了第 I 节所述的攻击 [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] 之外，技能会偏离声明的功能 [ 17 ]，MCP 服务器包含风险的双向数据流 [ 18]，工具投毒 [ 28] 与解析器漏洞利用 [ 29] 增加了攻击入口。 TUF [ 2 ]、in-toto [ 30 ] 与 Sigstore [ 3 ] 用于认证是谁发布了工件以及工件是如何构建的，这可以覆盖隐藏代码 [ 5 , 31 ]。 AgentBound [ 9 ] 与 MCPGuard-Dynamic [ 10 ] 建立在特权分离 [ 32 , 33 ]、能力机制 [ 34 ] 与沙箱 [ 23 ] 的基础上，将权限绑定到某个进程及其目标。 证明 [ 27 ]、来源绑定 [ 35 ]、追踪检查 [ 36 ]、事务式暂存 [ 37 ]、行动验证 [ 38 ] 与行动日志 [ 39 , 40 ] 决定的是某个行动是否可以发生，而不是该行动携带哪些条目。

paragraphs.en: Information flow, multi-execution and accountability. FIDES [ 11 ] and CaMeL [ 12 ] label tool replies and enforce flow policies in the planner, and TACIT restricts agent code with capture-checked types [ 41 ] ; their labels are sound when the reply depends only on the current call, whereas Corollary 2 also joins stored state. Our confinement premise follows Lampson [ 26 ] . Secure multi-execution [ 14 ] , faceted values [ 42 ] and multi-execution for language models [ 20 ] run a program once per security level, DIFC and taint tracking [ 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 ] propagate labels, and TightLip [ 47 ] and N-variant systems [ 48 ] compare replicas. Groundhog restores a FaaS process to a clean snapshot between requests [ 15 ] . PeerReview [ 49 ] and Arbitrum [ 50 ] make faults provable by replay, as our witnesses do for tool releases, and dampening adapts BGP route-flap damping [ 13 ] ; Section II-D states what germline execution adds to these ideas.
paragraphs.zh: 信息流、多重执行与问责。 FIDES [ 11 ] 与 CaMeL [ 12 ] 对工具返回结果打标签并在规划器中强制执行流策略，TACIT 则通过捕获检查类型限制智能体代码 [ 41 ] ；当返回结果仅依赖于当前调用时，它们的标签是可靠的，而推论 2 还会关联已存储的状态。 我们的受限前提遵循 Lampson [ 26 ] 。 安全多重执行 [ 14 ] 、分面值 [ 42 ] 以及面向语言模型的多重执行 [ 20 ] 会按每个安全级别运行一次程序，DIFC 与污点追踪 [ 43 , 44 , 45 , 46 ] 传播标签，而 TightLip [ 47 ] 与 N 变体系统 [ 48 ] 比较副本。 Groundhog 在请求之间将 FaaS 进程恢复到干净的快照 [ 15 ] 。 PeerReview [ 49 ] 与 Arbitrum [ 50 ] 通过重放使故障可证明，正如我们的见证对工具发布所做的那样，抑制机制则借鉴了 BGP 路由震荡抑制 [ 13 ] ；第 II-D 节说明了种系执行为这些思路新增的内容。

paragraphs.en: MCPGuard and AgentBound decide where a tool process may connect [ 10 , 9 ] , and germline execution which data each call carries there; each copy can run under the server’s kernel-level policy, so the two stack (not measured). The main policy burden is authoring labels and clearances, as in FIDES and CaMeL [ 11 , 12 ] , and declaring destinations in the manifest [ 9 ] . Stateful tools remain compatible when their state passes through the broker’s slots ( Section VII-D ); state kept only in process memory does not carry over, because every copy starts from the data-free germline. Concurrency, throughput, many resident releases and cloud-hosted services are future work.
paragraphs.zh: MCPGuard 与 AgentBound 决定工具进程可以连接到哪里 [10, 9]，而种系执行决定每次调用携带哪些数据去往那里；每个副本都可以在服务器的内核级策略下运行，因此两者可以叠加（未经验证）。 主要的策略负担在于编写标签与许可级别（如 FIDES 和 CaMeL [11, 12] 中那样），以及在清单中声明目标地址 [9]。 当有状态工具的状态经由代理的槽位传递时（第 VII-D 节），它们仍然保持兼容；仅保存在进程内存中的状态不会延续，因为每个副本都从不含数据的种系启动。 并发、吞吐量、大量驻留版本以及云端托管服务是未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: Within the disclosure-only scope of Section III-B , four boundaries apply.
paragraphs.zh: 在第三-B节的仅披露范围内，适用四条边界。

paragraphs.en: Remote tools. A tool we do not host cannot be forked or twinned, so it receives prevention through worst-case reply labels, at a utility cost ( Section VII-C ), but no witnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 远程工具。 我们不托管的工具无法被分叉或孪生，因此它通过最坏情况回复标签获得预防，付出效用代价（第 VII-C 节），但没有见证。

paragraphs.en: Labels from policy and integrity of effects. Theorem 1 protects data as labelled and bounds what a request carries, not whether it is wanted: a harmful data-free request, such as a delete command, needs action control [ 10 , 9 , 37 , 38 ] . A flow-compliant tool that passes data across horizons loses that function and fails closed ( O4 , Table XII ).
paragraphs.zh: 来自策略与效果完整性的标签。 定理1按标签保护数据，并限制请求所携带的内容，而不判断其是否被需要：一个有害的无数据请求，例如删除命令，需要行动控制[10, 9, 37, 38]。 一个符合流规则但在跨层级传递数据时会失去该功能并安全失效（fail closed）的工具（O4，表XII）。

paragraphs.en: A signature tells an agent who published a tool, and a confinement policy where it may connect, but neither tells it which data each call carries. Germline execution runs each call in copies forked from a data-free germline, provides sink noninterference for every signed release under the stated assumptions, and ties each verified flow violation to the exact release, at 10–49 ms per single-copy call.
paragraphs.zh: 签名告诉智能体工具由谁发布，隔离策略告诉它可以在哪里连接，但两者都无法告诉它每次调用携带的是哪些数据。 种系执行在从无数据的种系派生出的副本中运行每次调用，在所述假设下为每个已签名的发布版本提供汇聚点不干扰性，并将每个已验证的流违规绑定到确切的发布版本，单副本调用的开销为每次 10–49 毫秒。

paragraphs.en: This appendix proves the statements of Section V . Each proof begins with a one-line restatement and a sentence of intuition; the definitions, assumptions and labels are those of Sections V-A and V-B , and the mechanism is Plan together with Algorithm 1 . We use four structural facts, which hold by construction. (P1) Plan groups D f ∪ C k D_{f}\cup C_{k} by view, so all members of a group g g share one view, written V ⁡ ( g ) V(g) . (P2) After the split step, every destination host e e in a group g g satisfies c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( d ) c(e)\subseteq c(d) for every member d d of g g ; since e e is itself a member, all destination hosts in g g have the same clearance, and it equals the horizon κ ⁡ ( g ) \kappa(g) . (P3) Groups run one at a time in an order in which V ⁡ ( g ′ ) ⊊ V ⁡ ( g ) V(g^{\prime})\subsetneq V(g) implies that g ′ g^{\prime} runs before g g ; the order depends only on the inputs of Plan . (P4) There is one transcript and replay semantics, that of Definition 4 : every reply that a copy receives from a host outside its own group is the reply the positional rule gives from that host’s record at that moment, and the probe and the control receive the replies the same rule gives from T ⁡ ( d ) T(d) . In particular, the copy serving d d is itself an execution under ℛ ⁡ ( d ) \mathcal{R}(d) , because its transcript T ⁡ ( d ) T(d) records exactly the replies it was served, and replaying T ⁡ ( d ) T(d) by position to the same requests returns them again.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录证明第 V 节中的各项论断。 每个证明都以一行重述和一句直观说明开头；定义、假设和标签沿用第 V-A 节和第 V-B 节，机制为 Plan 与算法 1。 我们使用四个结构性事实，它们由构造即成立。 （P1）Plan 按视图对 D f ∪ C k D_{f}\cup C_{k} 进行分组，因此群组 g g 的所有成员共享同一个视图，记作 V ⁡ ( g ) V(g) 。 （P2）在拆分步骤之后，群组 g g 中的每个目标主机 e e 都满足：对 g g 的每个成员 d d 有 c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( d ) c(e)\subseteq c(d) ；由于 e e 本身也是成员， g g 中所有目标主机具有相同的许可，且等于视野 κ ⁡ ( g ) \kappa(g) 。 （P3）各群组按某一顺序逐个运行，该顺序满足：若 V ⁡ ( g ′ ) ⊊ V ⁡ ( g ) V(g^{\prime})\subsetneq V(g) ，则 g ′ g^{\prime} 先于 g g 运行；该顺序仅取决于 Plan 的输入。 （P4）存在唯一的转录与重放语义，即定义 4 的语义：一个副本从其所在群组之外的主机收到的每条回复，都是位置规则在该时刻根据该主机的记录给出的回复；探测与控制收到的是同一规则根据 T ⁡ ( d ) T(d) 给出的回复。 特别地，服务于 d d 的副本本身就是 ℛ ⁡ ( d ) \mathcal{R}(d) 下的一次执行，因为其转录 T ⁡ ( d ) T(d) 恰好记录了它被服务的回复，而按位置把 T ⁡ ( d ) T(d) 重放到相同的请求上会再次返回这些回复。

paragraphs.en: Call a value κ \kappa -bounded if it is computed only from the inputs listed in the lemma. We prove, by induction over the global sequence of broker messages (calls in order, groups in Plan order, messages in order), the stronger claim that every message sent by a copy of horizon κ \kappa , whether a request, a state write or a result, is κ \kappa -bounded, and that every label it stores lies inside κ \kappa . The lemma follows, because Algorithm 1 writes σ ⁡ [ κ ] \sigma[\kappa] only on a state write from a copy whose horizon is κ \kappa .
paragraphs.zh: 称一个值为 κ \kappa 有界的，如果它仅由引理中列出的输入计算得出。 我们对智能体消息的全局序列（调用按顺序、组按 Plan 顺序、消息按顺序）进行归纳，证明更强的命题：由视野为 κ \kappa 的副本发送的每条消息，无论是请求、状态写入还是结果，都是 κ \kappa 有界的，并且它存储的每个标签都位于 κ \kappa 之内。 该引理得证，因为算法 1 仅在来自视野为 κ \kappa 的副本的状态写入时写入 σ ⁡ [ κ ] \sigma[\kappa]。

paragraphs.en: Consider a copy of group g g with κ ⁡ ( g ) = κ \kappa(g)=\kappa . At fork its memory is the germline image M r M_{r} , which depends only on r r ( A2 ). The call message adds the metadata m k m_{k} , which is public ( A5 ); the twin inputs τ k \tau_{k} , which the broker chooses without reading item contents ( Definition 3 ); the contents of the items in V ⁡ ( g ) V(g) ; and the whole slot σ ⁡ [ κ ] \sigma[\kappa] with its label. By (P1), each item x ∈ V ⁡ ( g ) x\in V(g) satisfies ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( d ) \ell(x)\subseteq c(d) for every member d d of g g , hence ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ κ \ell(x)\subseteq\kappa , and the slot contents are κ \kappa -bounded, with labels inside κ \kappa , by the induction hypothesis. While it runs, the copy’s only input is the broker socket ( A1 ), and each broker reply takes one of three forms. (i) A live reply from a destination host e e in g g : by (P2), c ⁡ ( e ) = κ c(e)=\kappa . (ii) A reply to a request to a declared host e e outside g g , given by the positional rule (P4): the j j -th recorded reply of e e if the digests match and e e is admissible for g g , that is, c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ κ c(e)\subseteq\kappa , and the placeholder otherwise. (iii) A denial or a state acknowledgement: these are constants. Reaching the deadline gives the copy no input; it ends the copy. It remains to check that the outcome of the positional rule in form (ii) leaks nothing outside κ \kappa . If e e is not admissible for g g , the broker returns the placeholder whatever the requests are, so the outcome is constant; the same holds if e e ’s group has not yet run, because its record is still empty and the order of groups is fixed by (P3). If e e is admissible, the outcome depends on g g ’s own j j -th request to e e and on the record of e e , that is, the requests delivered to e e by an earlier group g e g_{e} and their replies. By the induction hypothesis that record is κ ⁡ ( g e ) \kappa(g_{e}) -bounded, and by (P2) κ ⁡ ( g e ) = c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ κ \kappa(g_{e})=c(e)\subseteq\kappa , so it is κ \kappa -bounded as well; a returned recorded reply carries the label c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ κ c(e)\subseteq\kappa ( A6 ). The copy is a program whose messages are a function of its initial memory and its input stream, and both are κ \kappa -bounded; hence so is every message it sends.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑群 g g 的一个副本，其中 κ ⁡ ( g ) = κ \kappa(g)=\kappa 。 在分叉时，它的记忆是种系镜像 M r M_{r} ，后者只依赖于 r r （A2）。 调用消息添加了元数据 m k m_{k} ，它是公开的（A5）；以及双重输入 τ k \tau_{k} ，由中介在不读取条目内容的情况下选择（定义 3）；还包括 V ⁡ ( g ) V(g) 中条目的内容；以及带标签的整个槽位 σ ⁡ [ κ ] \sigma[\kappa] 。 由 (P1)，每个条目 x ∈ V ⁡ ( g ) x\in V(g) 对 g g 的每个成员 d d 都满足 ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( d ) \ell(x)\subseteq c(d) ，因此 ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ κ \ell(x)\subseteq\kappa ，并且由归纳假设，槽位内容是 κ \kappa 有界的，标签也在 κ \kappa 之内。 在运行期间，该副本的唯一输入是中介套接字（A1），而中介的每次回复取三种形式之一。 (i) 来自 g g 中某个目标主机 e e 的存活回复：由 (P2)，c ⁡ ( e ) = κ c(e)=\kappa 。 (ii) 对 g g 之外某个已声明主机 e e 的请求的回复，由位置规则 (P4) 给出：若摘要匹配且 e e 对 g g 可准入，即 c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ κ c(e)\subseteq\kappa ，则为 e e 的第 j j 条已记录回复，否则为占位符。 (iii) 拒绝或状态确认：这些是常量。 到达截止时限不会给副本任何输入；它结束该副本。 剩下要检查的是形式 (ii) 中位置规则的结果不会泄漏 κ \kappa 之外的任何信息。 若 e e 对 g g 不可准入，则无论请求是什么，中介都返回占位符，因此结果是常量；若 e e 所在的群尚未运行，情况也一样，因为其记录仍为空，并且群的顺序由 (P3) 固定。 若 e e 可准入，则结果取决于 g g 自身对 e e 的第 j j 个请求以及 e e 的记录，即由更早的群 g e g_{e} 递送给 e e 的请求及其回复。 由归纳假设，该记录是 κ ⁡ ( g e ) \kappa(g_{e}) 有界的，而由 (P2)，κ ⁡ ( g e ) = c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ κ \kappa(g_{e})=c(e)\subseteq\kappa ，因此它也是 κ \kappa 有界的；返回的已记录回复带有标签 c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ κ c(e)\subseteq\kappa （A6）。 该副本是一个程序，其消息是其初始记忆和输入流的函数，而二者都是 κ \kappa 有界的；因此它发送的每条消息也是如此。

sents.en: It remains to check that the outcome of the positional rule in form (ii) leaks nothing outside κ \kappa .

sents.en: The copy is a program whose messages are a function of its initial memory and its input stream, and both are κ \kappa -bounded; hence so is every message it sends.

paragraphs.en: Finally, the label stored with a state write is the join of g g ’s view labels, the label of the slot it received and the clearances of hosts whose replies reached it, each of which lies inside κ \kappa by (P1), the induction hypothesis, (P2) and admissibility. ∎

paragraphs.en: Step 3: g g receives only allowed inputs while it runs. By A1 , the copy’s only channel is its broker socket, and by A3 the broker behaves as specified. By (P4), each reply to a request to a declared host is a live reply of a host in g g , which is admissible by (P2), or the outcome of the positional rule, which is an admissible recorded reply or the placeholder; together these are exactly the answers of the reply environment ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) to g g ’s requests. The remaining broker messages, denials and state acknowledgements, are constants. By the proof of Lemma 1 , every reply in ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) and every outcome of the positional rule is κ k ​ ( d ) \kappa_{k}(d) -bounded; in particular, the records it draws on come from groups g e g_{e} with V ⁡ ( g e ) ⊆ V k ​ ( d ) V(g_{e})\subseteq V_{k}(d) , because ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( d ) \ell(x)\subseteq c(e)\subseteq c(d) for every item they hold, so ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) does not depend on the contents of items outside V k ​ ( d ) V_{k}(d) .

sents.en: By the proof of Lemma 1 , every reply in ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) and every outcome of the positional rule is κ k ​ ( d ) \kappa_{k}(d) -bounded; in particular, the records it draws on come from groups g e g_{e} with V ⁡ ( g e ) ⊆ V k ​ ( d ) V(g_{e})\subseteq V_{k}(d) , because ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( d ) \ell(x)\subseteq c(e)\subseteq c(d) for every item they hold, so ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) does not depend on the contents of items outside V k ​ ( d ) V_{k}(d) .
sents.zh: 根据引理 1 的证明，ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) 中的每条回复以及位置规则的每个结果都是 κ k ​ ( d ) \kappa_{k}(d) 有界的；特别是，它们所依据的记录来自满足 V ⁡ ( g e ) ⊆ V k ​ ( d ) V(g_{e})\subseteq V_{k}(d) 的分组 g e g_{e}，因为对于它们所持有的每个条目都有 ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( d ) \ell(x)\subseteq c(e)\subseteq c(d)，所以 ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) 不依赖于 V k ​ ( d ) V_{k}(d) 之外条目的内容。

paragraphs.en: Step 4: conclusion. A copy is a program whose j j -th message is a function of its initial memory and the replies to its earlier messages. By Steps 2 and 3, the initial memory is a function of m k m_{k} , X k | V k ​ ( d ) X_{k}|_{V_{k}(d)} , σ ​ [ κ k ​ ( d ) ] \sigma[\kappa_{k}(d)] and τ k \tau_{k} , and the replies are given by ℛ k ​ ( d ) \mathcal{R}_{k}(d) . Induction over the sequence of broker messages shows that the copy’s request sequence to d d is such a function, and by Step 1 it is the sequence delivered to d d . If the copy is killed at the deadline, d d receives a prefix of that sequence; which prefix is a matter of timing, which A1 places outside the model. A deadline can change the inputs of a later copy only through the length of a record: if the copy of a group g e g_{e} is killed, the record of each host e e in g e g_{e} is truncated, and a later copy to which e e is admissible receives placeholders at the missing positions. That record lies inside c ⁡ ( e ) ⊆ κ k ​ ( d ) c(e)\subseteq\kappa_{k}(d) by Step 3, and its length is again timing, so the argument above is unchanged for every combination of deadlines. If r r draws on randomness that the broker does not control, the copy is a randomised program, and the same induction shows that the distribution of its output stream is a function of the same five arguments. ∎

paragraphs.en: Equation 2 is the label the prototype computes ( Algorithm 1 ): it joins the labels of the copy’s view, the clearance of every host whose reply reached the copy, including admissible recorded replies from hosts outside g g ( O4 ), and the label of the delivered slot. The label regression test ( Table VI ) checks the slot term: an HR item stored by one call and recalled by a later call with only public inputs is returned with the label hr , so a downstream policy engine refuses to forward it to a public sink, whereas a public-only control keeps the label ∅ \emptyset and is forwarded. Joining the horizon κ ⁡ ( g ) \kappa(g) instead of ℓ ⁡ ( σ g ) \ell(\sigma_{g}) for a non-empty slot is also sound but coarser, because it labels a recalled public entry as if it held everything the horizon admits. The second term also covers the match outcome: the positional rule tells a copy whether its j j -th request to an admissible host e e outside g g matched the recorded one, since it receives either the recorded reply or the placeholder, so the prototype joins c ⁡ ( e ) c(e) whenever the copy sends a request to an admissible host with a non-empty record, matched or not. paragraphs.en: Restatement of Theorem 2 . For a release that is deterministic within the replay model, (a) an item witness implies a flow violation toward d d , (b) a flow-compliant release never yields an item witness, and (c) in a multi-copy call, every difference between the delivered sequence and the request sequence to d d of a comparing copy whose view strictly contains V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) and that finishes within its deadline raises a trigger that probe replay classifies. The intuition is that replay equalises every argument d d may depend on, so any remaining difference must come from items d d may not see.
paragraphs.zh: 定理2的重述。 对于在重放模型内确定性的发布：(a) 项证人意味着一个朝向 d d 的流违规；(b) 符合流的发布从不产生项证人；(c) 在多副本调用中，对于其视图严格包含 V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) 且在其截止期限内完成的比较副本，其交付序列与发往 d d 的请求序列之间的每一个差异都会触发一个由探针重放进行分类的触发器。 直觉是重放使 d d 可能依赖的所有参数都趋于一致，因此任何剩余的差异必然来自 d d 可能看不到的项。

paragraphs.en: (a) Let r r be deterministic within the replay model, and suppose an item witness for ( r , d ) (r,d) exists, so the probe’s request sequence to d d differs from the delivered one. By the observation above, the probe and g g agree on all five arguments of Eq. 1 , including the reply environment through which each of them is answered, and differ only in contents of items outside V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) . Because r r is deterministic within the replay model, each execution’s request sequence is a function of its inputs and its reply environment, so the two executions agree on the five arguments yet send different request sequences to d d , which is a flow violation by Definition 5 . The N N repeated tries and the control are not needed for this implication when r r is deterministic; they make the verdict robust in practice, because a release that draws on a source outside A4 can fail the control and is then never reported as an item witness.
paragraphs.zh: (a) 设 r 在回放模型内是确定性的，并假设存在 (r, d) 的条目见证，使得探测方发送给 d 的请求序列与实际送达的请求序列不同。 根据上述观察，探测方与 g 在式 1 的全部五个参数上一致，包括应答它们各自所处的回复环境，二者仅在 V(d) 之外的条目内容上不同。 由于 r 在回放模型内是确定性的，每次执行的请求序列是其输入及其回复环境的函数，因此两次执行在五个参数上一致，却向 d 发送了不同的请求序列，根据定义 5 这构成一次流违例。 当 r 是确定性的时，这一推论不需要 N 次重复尝试和对照；它们使判定在实践中更加稳健，因为一个依赖 A4 之外来源的发布可能无法通过对照检验，从而永远不会被报告为条目见证。

paragraphs.en: (c) Let g ′ g^{\prime} be a copy with V ⁡ ( g ′ ) ⊋ V ⁡ ( d ) V(g^{\prime})\supsetneq V(d) that finishes within its deadline; by (P3) it runs after g g , so when g ′ g^{\prime} runs the record of d d holds every request delivered to d d : the complete sequence if g g finished, and otherwise the prefix delivered before g g was killed at the deadline. For the j j -th request of g ′ g^{\prime} to d d , the broker compares its digest with that of the j j -th request delivered to d d , and records a trigger at the first position where they differ or where the record has no j j -th entry; when g ′ g^{\prime} ends, it records a trigger if g ′ g^{\prime} sent fewer requests to d d than were delivered, including none. A difference in content, count or order, or a request absent from either sequence, produces a first position at which the two sequences differ, or a shorter sequence from g ′ g^{\prime} , so each such difference raises a trigger. Probe replay then runs the probe and the control N N times each. If the control ever differs from the delivered sequence, the trigger is classified as nondeterminism outside A4 ( Proposition 2 ); otherwise, if the probe differs on all N N tries, it is an item witness, and if it never differs, it is a state or response divergence ( Proposition 1 ); a probe that differs on some tries only is also classified as nondeterminism. For a release that is deterministic within the replay model and whose copy g g finished, the control never differs and every probe try gives the same result, so the trigger is an item witness, which is a flow violation by (a), or a state or response divergence. If g g was killed, the record is a prefix whose length is a matter of timing ( A1 ); whenever the control does not reproduce that prefix, the trigger is classified as nondeterminism and not as an item witness. ∎
paragraphs.zh: (c) 设 g′g^{\prime} 是一个满足 V(g′)⊋V(d) 且在其截止期限内完成的副本；根据 (P3)，它在 g 之后运行，因此当 g′ 运行时，d 的记录包含已投递给 d 的每个请求：若 g 已完成，则为完整序列，否则为在截止期限处 g 被终止前已投递的前缀。 对于 g′ 发往 d 的第 j 个请求，broker 将其摘要与已投递给 d 的第 j 个请求的摘要进行比较，并在二者首次不同的位置或记录中没有第 j 个条目的位置记录一个触发器；当 g′ 结束时，若 g′ 发往 d 的请求数少于已投递的数量（包括为零的情况），它也记录一个触发器。 内容、数量或顺序上的差异，或某一请求只在其中一个序列中出现，都会产生两个序列首次不同的位置，或得到来自 g′ 的更短序列，因此每一处这样的差异都会引发一个触发器。 探针重放随后将探针和对照各运行 N 次。 若对照与已投递序列出现差异，则该触发器被归类为 A4 之外的非确定性（命题 2）；否则，若探针在全部 N 次尝试中都出现差异，则它是一个条目见证，若它从未出现差异，则它是一次状态或响应分歧（命题 1）；仅在部分尝试中出现差异的探针同样被归类为非确定性。 对于在重放模型内是确定性的、且其副本 g 已完成的发布，对照从不出现差异且每次探针尝试都给出相同结果，因此该触发器是一个条目 witness，根据 (a) 它构成一次流违规，或是一次状态或响应分歧。 若 g 被终止，则该记录是一个前缀，其长度取决于时序（A1）；只要对照未能复现该前缀，该触发器就被归类为非确定性而非条目见证。∎

sents.en: For a release that is deterministic within the replay model and whose copy g g finished, the control never differs and every probe try gives the same result, so the trigger is an item witness, which is a flow violation by (a), or a state or response divergence.

sents.en: If g g was killed, the record is a prefix whose length is a matter of timing ( A1 ); whenever the control does not reproduce that prefix, the trigger is classified as nondeterminism and not as an item witness. ∎
sents.zh: 若 g 被终止，则该记录是一个前缀，其长度取决于时序（A1）；只要对照未能复现该前缀，该触发器就被归类为非确定性而非条目见证。∎

paragraphs.en: Dampening gives such an event the weight of an unverified event, 250 at the operating point ( Table XIV ).
paragraphs.zh: 阻尼使此类事件的权重等同于未经验证的事件，在工作点处为 250（表 XIV）。

If the comparing copy’s sequence to d d differs from the delivered one while the probe’s equals it, then, by determinism, the difference is caused by the slot or the replies, not by the contents of W ∖ V ⁡ ( d ) W\setminus V(d) . The comparing copy’s requests are never delivered to d d (Step 1 of the proof of Theorem 1 ), so nothing is disclosed. A flow-compliant tool that keeps a call counter per horizon produces exactly this pattern, because counters in different slots differ; hence the event cannot be attributed to a flow violation and receives the unverified weight ( Table XIV ). ∎

paragraphs.en: If r r draws on sources outside A4 , the control can fail and replay cannot confirm a flow violation; a release that declared determinism in its signed metadata and fails the control contradicts a declaration its signature attributes to the publisher.

paragraphs.en: If the control, run on g g ’s exact inputs under ℛ ⁡ ( d ) \mathcal{R}(d) , produces a sequence different from the delivered one, then the output of r r is not a function of the inputs that the broker controls, so r r draws on a source outside A4 . paragraphs.en: The mechanism class is the one stated in Theorem 3 . A mechanism in the class treats the release as a black box: it learns the release’s behaviour only by running it, and every request it delivers and every value it returns is produced by some run of the release on some item set U ⊆ X k U\subseteq X_{k} , in which the items outside U U arrive as names with empty contents. A data-independent fork rule ( Definition 7 ) fixes these runs, and the output rule that assigns to each member of D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C the run whose output it receives, before any run starts and without reading the release’s code; two releases with the same manifest therefore receive the same runs and the same output rule. For consumers, we read the requirement of Theorem 1 in its natural form for return values: a consumer receives nothing derived from items outside its view.
paragraphs.zh: 该机制类即定理 3 中所述的机制类。 该类中的机制将发布物视为黑箱：它仅通过运行发布物来了解其行为，且它发出的每个请求和返回的每个值都由发布物在某个条目集合 U ⊆ X_{k} 上的一次运行产生，其中 U 之外的条目以内容为空的名称形式到达。 数据无关的分叉规则（定义 7）预先固定这些运行，并在任何运行开始之前、不读取发布物代码的情况下，固定为 D_{f}∪C 中每个成员分配其接收输出的运行的输出规则；因此，具有相同清单的两个发布物会得到相同的运行和相同的输出规则。 对于消费者，我们以返回值的自然形式来解读定理 1 的要求：消费者不会接收到任何源自其视图之外条目的内容。

paragraphs.en: Restatement of Theorem 3 . (a) A mechanism in this class that prevents disclosure for every release and is transparent needs a run on each distinct view among D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C and, within a view, one per distinct host clearance plus one for the consumers whose clearance contains no host clearance of that view; (b) Plan creates exactly these runs. The intuition is that a flow-compliant release can encode its whole view into each output, so every distinct view, and every clearance that changes which replies a run may see, needs its own run.
paragraphs.zh: 定理3的重述。 (a) 该类中防止每次发布发生泄露且透明的机制，需要在 D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C 中的每个不同视图上各运行一次，并且在同一视图内，对每个不同的主机许可各运行一次，再为许可不包含该视图任何主机许可的消费者增加一次运行；(b) Plan 恰好创建了这些运行。 其直觉在于，一个符合流规则的发布可以将其整个视图编码进每个输出中，因此每个不同的视图，以及每个会改变某次运行所能看到的回复的许可，都需要各自独立的一次运行。

paragraphs.en: (a), views. Fix a call and a member d d of D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C , and consider two releases with the same manifest. Release r 1 r_{1} sends to every declared destination host, and returns to every consumer, an injective encoding of the contents of all items it holds. Release r 2 r_{2} sends to each declared host e e , and returns to each consumer e e , an injective encoding of the contents of the items x x with ℓ ⁡ ( x ) ⊆ c ⁡ ( e ) \ell(x)\subseteq c(e) ; it can compute this set because labels and clearances are public. Release r 2 r_{2} is flow-compliant, whereas r 1 r_{1} is not. The output rule assigns to d d one run, on some item set U U . Because the runs and the output rule are fixed by a data-independent rule from f f , m m , labels, clearances, D f D_{f} and C C , which are the same for r 1 r_{1} and r 2 r_{2} , the rule assigns to d d a run on the same set U U under both releases. This step uses the data independence of the output rule and not only of the runs: a mechanism that fixed its runs in advance but chose which run’s output to deliver after observing the outputs could choose differently for r 1 r_{1} and r 2 r_{2} . If U U contains an item outside V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) , then under r 1 r_{1} what d d receives depends on that item’s contents, which contradicts Theorem 1 . If U U misses an item y ∈ V ⁡ ( d ) y\in V(d) , then under r 2 r_{2} what d d receives does not depend on y y ’s contents, because y y arrives empty, while transparency requires the injective encoding of X | V ⁡ ( d ) X|_{V(d)} , which does; for some contents of y y the two differ. Hence U = V ⁡ ( d ) U=V(d) , and since the rule is fixed before any run, the mechanism needs a run on each distinct view among D f ∪ C D_{f}\cup C .
paragraphs.zh: (a)，视图。 固定一个调用以及 D_f ∪ C 中的一个成员 d，并考虑两个具有相同清单的发布。 发布 r₁ 向每个声明的目标主机发送，并向每个消费者返回，其持有的所有项的内容的单射编码。 发布 r₂ 向每个声明的主机 e 发送，并向每个消费者 e 返回，满足 ℓ(x) ⊆ c(e) 的项 x 的内容的单射编码；它可以计算这个集合，因为标签和许可都是公开的。 发布 r₂ 是符合流规则的，而 r₁ 则不是。 输出规则将某个项集 U 上的一次运行分配给 d。 由于运行和输出规则是由一个数据无关的规则从 f、m、标签、许可、D_f 和 C 固定的，而这些在 r₁ 和 r₂ 下是相同的，因此该规则在两次发布下都给 d 分配了在同一个集合 U 上的运行。 这一步用到的是输出规则的数据无关性，而不仅仅是运行的数据无关性：一个预先固定了其运行、但在观察到输出之后才选择交付哪个运行的输出的机制，可能会为 r₁ 和 r₂ 做出不同的选择。 如果 U 包含一个位于 V(d) 之外的项，那么在 r₁ 下 d 所接收的内容依赖于该项的内容，这与定理 1 矛盾。 如果 U 缺少一个属于 V(d) 的项 y，那么在 r₂ 下 d 所接收的内容不依赖于 y 的内容，因为 y 到达时为空，而透明性要求对 X|_{V(d)} 的单射编码，而该编码确实依赖于它；对于 y 的某些内容，两者会有所不同。 因此 U = V(d)，并且由于该规则在任何运行之前就被固定，所以该机制需要对 D_f ∪ C 中每个不同的视图都有一次运行。

paragraphs.en: (a), groups. Let e 1 e_{1} and e 2 e_{2} be destination hosts with the same view and c ⁡ ( e 1 ) ⊈ c ⁡ ( e 2 ) c(e_{1})\not\subseteq c(e_{2}) . Consider a flow-compliant release that first sends a request to e 1 e_{1} , then sends to e 2 e_{2} an injective encoding of the reply it received from e 1 e_{1} , and then sends to e 1 e_{1} a second request that also encodes that reply. The reply of e 1 e_{1} is not admissible for e 2 e_{2} , so by Definition 7 the transparent sequence for e 2 e_{2} is computed with the placeholder in its place, while the transparent sequence for e 1 e_{1} is computed with e 1 e_{1} ’s real reply. A single run receives either the real reply or the placeholder. With the real reply, its request to e 2 e_{2} differs from the transparent one whenever the reply differs from the placeholder, and it also carries e 1 e_{1} ’s data to e 2 e_{2} ; with the placeholder, its second request to e 1 e_{1} differs from the transparent one. Hence e 1 e_{1} and e 2 e_{2} need separate runs. The same argument, with a return value in place of the request to e 2 e_{2} , separates a consumer from any destination host whose clearance is not inside the consumer’s.

sents.en: (a), groups.

sents.en: Consider a flow-compliant release that first sends a request to e 1 e_{1} , then sends to e 2 e_{2} an injective encoding of the reply it received from e 1 e_{1} , and then sends to e 1 e_{1} a second request that also encodes that reply.

sents.en: The reply of e 1 e_{1} is not admissible for e 2 e_{2} , so by Definition 7 the transparent sequence for e 2 e_{2} is computed with the placeholder in its place, while the transparent sequence for e 1 e_{1} is computed with e 1 e_{1} ’s real reply.

sents.zh: 单次运行要么收到真实回复，要么收到占位符。

sents.en: With the real reply, its request to e 2 e_{2} differs from the transparent one whenever the reply differs from the placeholder, and it also carries e 1 e_{1} ’s data to e 2 e_{2} ; with the placeholder, its second request to e 1 e_{1} differs from the transparent one.

paragraphs.en: (b). Within each view, Plan partitions the destination hosts by clearance, attaches each consumer to a part whose clearance lies inside its own, and places the remaining consumers of that view together in one part. Two hosts with different clearances violate inclusion in at least one direction, so the groups argument of (a) forces one run per distinct clearance among the hosts of a view. A remaining consumer has no host in its view whose clearance lies inside its own, so (a) forces it to run apart from every host part. Remaining consumers can share a run, because consumers return no replies and every host reply is inadmissible for all of them. Every part Plan creates is therefore forced, and Plan creates no others, so its number of copies equals the lower bound of (a) within this class. ∎
paragraphs.zh: (b)。 在每个视图内，Plan 按密级划分目标主机，把每个消费者挂到一个密级包含其自身密级的分区，并将该视图中其余的消费者一起放在一个分区里。 两个密级不同的主机至少在一个方向上违反包含关系，因此 (a) 的分组论证迫使一个视图中每出现一种不同的密级就要多一次运行。 剩余的消费者在其视图中没有任何密级包含其自身密级的主机，因此 (a) 迫使它与每个主机分区分开运行。 剩余的消费者可以共享一次运行，因为消费者不返回任何回复，而且所有主机回复对它们来说都是不可采纳的。 因此 Plan 创建的每个分区都是被迫的，并且 Plan 不创建其他分区，所以其副本数等于该类别中 (a) 的下界。∎

paragraphs.en: Restatement of Lemma 2 . Under lazy splitting, whether d d receives any request reveals one bit of uncleared data per call, invisibly to the tripwire. The intuition is that the existence of d d ’s copy, and hence of any request to d d , is decided by a copy that holds data d d may not see.
paragraphs.zh: 引理 2 的重述。 在惰性分裂下，d d 是否收到任何请求会在每次调用中泄露一位未清除的数据，而对绊线是不可见的。 直觉是：d d 的副本是否存在，从而对 d d 的任何请求是否存在，是由一个持有 d d 可能无法看到的数据的副本决定的。

sents.en: Restatement of Lemma 2 .

sents.zh: 直觉是：d d 的副本是否存在，从而对 d d 的任何请求是否存在，是由一个持有 d d 可能无法看到的数据的副本决定的。

paragraphs.en: Under lazy splitting, the copy with view V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) is forked only when the full-view copy contacts d d . Consider a release that, in the full-view copy, contacts d d if and only if a chosen bit b b of an item outside V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) equals 1, and whose request to d d does not depend on any uncleared content. Then d d receives a request exactly when b = 1 b=1 , so the presence of a request reveals b b : one bit per call and destination host. When b = 1 b=1 , the delivered request comes from the copy with view V ⁡ ( d ) V(d) and, by construction, equals the full-view copy’s request; when b = 0 b=0 , no copy for d d exists and nothing is compared. In neither case does the tripwire record a trigger. Under declared-destination splitting, the copy for d d is forked whenever d ∈ D f d\in D_{f} , independently of item contents, and the bit disappears. In the existence-bit test, when the copy that cannot see the secret falls back to sending a request, which is the release constructed above, lazy splitting recovers 64 of 64 secret bits (0.942 bits per call); declared-destination splitting recovers no information under either fallback (0.000 bits per call; accuracy at the constant-guess baseline); with declared-destination splitting the sequence comparison also raises a trigger on every secret-dependent attempt, 23 of 23 when the release sends only if the bit is 1 and 41 of 41 when it sends only if the bit is 0 ( Section VII-E ). ∎
paragraphs.zh: 在惰性拆分下，只有当全视图副本与 d d 联系时，视图为 V(d) 的副本才被分叉。 考虑一个 release，它在全视图副本中当且仅当 V(d) 之外的某个条目的选定比特 b b 等于 1 时才联系 d d，并且它对 d d 的请求不依赖于任何未清除的内容。 那么 d d 恰好在 b=1 时收到请求，因此请求的存在性就泄露了 b：每次调用和目标主机泄露一比特。 当 b=1 时，被投递的请求来自视图为 V(d) 的副本，并且按构造等于全视图副本的请求；当 b=0 时，不存在针对 d 的副本，也就没有任何比较。 在这两种情况下，绊线都不会记录到触发。 在声明目标拆分下，只要 d ∈ D_f 就会为 d 分叉副本，与条目内容无关，该比特便消失了。 在存在比特测试中，当无法看到秘密的副本退回到发送请求（即上文构造的 release）时，惰性拆分恢复了 64 个秘密比特中的 64 个（每次调用 0.942 比特）；声明目标拆分在两种回退下都未恢复任何信息（每次调用 0.000 比特；准确率处于常数猜测基线水平）；在声明目标拆分下，序列比较还会在每次依赖秘密的尝试上都触发绊线，当 release 仅在比特为 1 时发送为 23 次中的 23 次，当它仅在比特为 0 时发送为 41 次中的 41 次（第 VII-E 节）。∎

paragraphs.en: Generation protocol for the generated variants (E13). We generated the variants ourselves. They target the read_note tool of MCPGuard’s signed note server, at the same commit 825fdc0a as the MCPGuard build of Section VII-A . A pipeline built with an LLM coding agent (Codex) prompts a local Qwen3.5-27B model on vLLM [ 51 ] (temperature 0.8, seed 13000 + i 13000+i for attempt i i , at most 1800 tokens, reasoning off). Each prompt asks for one pure Python function candidate(data, state, phase, triggered) that returns the effects prescribed for its family (for example, return the stored data on the second phase for carry-over), forbids imports, files, sockets and process calls, and asks for a control and data flow distinct from the eight most recent accepted structures; a static checker enforces these rules, and fixed adapters around the unchanged read_note handler turn the returned effects into requests. Of 189 attempts, 97 were rejected at generation and 92 were packaged as distinct programs (unique normalised syntax trees) in five families: direct (20), allowed-request (20), dormant (20), triggered (18) and carry-over (14). We adapted each package to our runner, signed it, and admitted it only if its output matches the clean tool and it discloses a canary with no defence. The adaptation rewrites the packaging (manifest fields, module layout and call scenario) and connects the generated canaries to our oracle; the payloads already sent their requests through urllib , which the broker relays, and the admission check confirms that every admitted variant still discloses without a defence. Variants are distinct as normalised syntax trees; we did not measure their semantic similarity within a family. All 92 are functional, and 91 are admitted: one triggered variant did not disclose without a defence and was dropped. We tagged each admitted case by where it sends data: 71 to an attacker-owned host that no policy lists, and 20 to a host the policy allows.
paragraphs.zh: 生成变体的生成协议（E13）。 这些变体由我们自己生成。 它们针对 MCPGuard 的签名笔记服务器中的 read_note 工具，提交号同为第七节 A 小节中 MCPGuard 构建所用的 825fdc0a。 一个由 LLM 编码智能体（Codex）构建的流水线，在 vLLM [51] 上提示本地 Qwen3.5-27B 模型（温度 0.8，第 i 次尝试使用种子 13000+i，最多 1800 个 token，关闭推理模式）。 每个提示要求生成一个纯 Python 函数 candidate(data, state, phase, triggered)，该函数返回其家族所规定的效果（例如，对于 carry-over 家族，在第二个阶段返回存储的数据），禁止导入、文件、套接字和进程调用，并要求控制流和数据流不同于最近接受的八个结构；静态检查器强制执行这些规则，围绕未更改的 read_note 处理器的固定适配器将返回的效果转换为请求。 在 189 次尝试中，97 次在生成阶段被拒绝，92 个被打包为五个家族中的不同程序（归一化语法树唯一）：direct（20 个）、allowed-request（20 个）、dormant（20 个）、triggered（18 个）和 carry-over（14 个）。 我们将每个包适配到我们的运行器，对其进行签名，并且仅当其输出与干净工具匹配且在无防御情况下泄露金丝雀数据时才予以接纳。 适配过程重写了打包方式（清单字段、模块布局和调用场景），并将生成的金丝雀连接到我们的判定器；载荷已经通过 urllib 发送其请求，由代理中继，接纳检查确认每个被接纳的变体在无防御情况下仍然会泄露。 各变体在归一化语法树上是不同的；我们没有测量同一家族内变体之间的语义相似度。 全部 92 个均可用，其中 91 个被接纳：一个 triggered 变体在无防御情况下未泄露数据，因此被剔除。 我们按数据发送位置对每个被接纳的案例进行标记：71 个发送到没有任何策略列出的攻击者拥有的主机，20 个发送到策略允许的主机。

sents.zh: 它们针对 MCPGuard 的签名笔记服务器中的 read_note 工具，提交号同为第七节 A 小节中 MCPGuard 构建所用的 825fdc0a。

sents.en: A pipeline built with an LLM coding agent (Codex) prompts a local Qwen3.5-27B model on vLLM [ 51 ] (temperature 0.8, seed 13000 + i 13000+i for attempt i i , at most 1800 tokens, reasoning off).
sents.zh: 一个由 LLM 编码智能体（Codex）构建的流水线，在 vLLM [51] 上提示本地 Qwen3.5-27B 模型（温度 0.8，第 i 次尝试使用种子 13000+i，最多 1800 个 token，关闭推理模式）。

sents.en: Each prompt asks for one pure Python function candidate(data, state, phase, triggered) that returns the effects prescribed for its family (for example, return the stored data on the second phase for carry-over), forbids imports, files, sockets and process calls, and asks for a control and data flow distinct from the eight most recent accepted structures; a static checker enforces these rules, and fixed adapters around the unchanged read_note handler turn the returned effects into requests.
sents.zh: 每个提示要求生成一个纯 Python 函数 candidate(data, state, phase, triggered)，该函数返回其家族所规定的效果（例如，对于 carry-over 家族，在第二个阶段返回存储的数据），禁止导入、文件、套接字和进程调用，并要求控制流和数据流不同于最近接受的八个结构；静态检查器强制执行这些规则，围绕未更改的 read_note 处理器的固定适配器将返回的效果转换为请求。

sents.en: Of 189 attempts, 97 were rejected at generation and 92 were packaged as distinct programs (unique normalised syntax trees) in five families: direct (20), allowed-request (20), dormant (20), triggered (18) and carry-over (14).
sents.zh: 在 189 次尝试中，97 次在生成阶段被拒绝，92 个被打包为五个家族中的不同程序（归一化语法树唯一）：direct（20 个）、allowed-request（20 个）、dormant（20 个）、triggered（18 个）和 carry-over（14 个）。

sents.en: We adapted each package to our runner, signed it, and admitted it only if its output matches the clean tool and it discloses a canary with no defence.
sents.zh: 我们将每个包适配到我们的运行器，对其进行签名，并且仅当其输出与干净工具匹配且在无防御情况下泄露金丝雀数据时才予以接纳。

sents.en: The adaptation rewrites the packaging (manifest fields, module layout and call scenario) and connects the generated canaries to our oracle; the payloads already sent their requests through urllib , which the broker relays, and the admission check confirms that every admitted variant still discloses without a defence.
sents.zh: 适配过程重写了打包方式（清单字段、模块布局和调用场景），并将生成的金丝雀连接到我们的判定器；载荷已经通过 urllib 发送其请求，由代理中继，接纳检查确认每个被接纳的变体在无防御情况下仍然会泄露。

sents.en: Variants are distinct as normalised syntax trees; we did not measure their semantic similarity within a family.
sents.zh: 各变体在归一化语法树上是不同的；我们没有测量同一家族内变体之间的语义相似度。

sents.en: All 92 are functional, and 91 are admitted: one triggered variant did not disclose without a defence and was dropped.
sents.zh: 全部 92 个均可用，其中 91 个被接纳：一个 triggered 变体在无防御情况下未泄露数据，因此被剔除。

sents.en: We tagged each admitted case by where it sends data: 71 to an attacker-owned host that no policy lists, and 20 to a host the policy allows.
sents.zh: 我们按数据发送位置对每个被接纳的案例进行标记：71 个发送到没有任何策略列出的攻击者拥有的主机，20 个发送到策略允许的主机。

paragraphs.en: Security matrix per variant (E1). Table XI breaks the 153 attack runs per runtime of Fig. 3 down by attack variant, and Fig. 3 in Section VII-C shows the same counts as disclosure rates. The breakdown shows which object each defence binds authority to. Confinement in Confined+IFC stops every variant that needs an unlisted destination host ( direct , filesteal ) and every attack on initialisation ( init_read , init_thread , hijack ), but not the remaining ten variants: those that travel inside authorised requests ( pool , smuggle , launder , launder_text ), those that wait or react to content ( dormant , trigger ), the adaptive variants evasive and capsule , the dependency bump dep , and the cross-tool composition xtool . A fresh process per call in Fresh+IFC removes most carry-over but still discloses in 3 of 15 runs each for evasive , launder , pool and smuggle , and for xtool in every run, because one call still mixes differently labelled items. The ablation Germline -NoSplit closes the cross-tool case but still discloses through the within-call variants evasive , launder and pool , which is the gap that declared-destination splitting closes. Germline discloses in none of the 153 runs and records 12 triggers along the way, which feed the witness evaluation of Section VII-E . Prevention costs no utility in this matrix: the benign workload completes 99 of 99 steps correctly under every runtime, and the benign release discloses in 0 of 15 runs under Germline . The counts in Figs. 3 and XI include every detected disclosure in an attack run, including disclosures that the agent makes itself. Under Sig+Pin, which has no output labels, the agent forwards protected replies itself: in 3 of the 15 benign-release runs, and in all 6 attack runs of hijack and init_thread (marked † ), in which the tool itself discloses nothing. By the attribution rule of Section VII-A , these 6 runs are not attributable to the tool, so the tool discloses in 108 of the 153 Sig+Pin runs, as under Sig+IFC; the gap between 114 and 108 is the agent’s own forwarding. The vector column follows the mapping of Section III-B : the eleven V1 variants contribute 105 runs, trigger 15 runs to V1 + V2 , xtool 3 runs to V1 + V3 , and the two laundering variants 30 runs to V1 + V4 .
paragraphs.zh: 每个变体的安全矩阵（E1）。 表 XI 将图 3 中每个运行时的 153 次攻击运行按攻击变体进行分解，第 VII-C 节中的图 3 将相同的计数显示为披露率。 该分解显示了每种防御将权限绑定到哪个对象。 Confined+IFC 中的隔离阻止了每一个需要未列出目标主机的变体（direct、filesteal）以及所有针对初始化的攻击（init_read、init_thread、hijack），但无法阻止其余十个变体：在授权请求内部传播的变体（pool、smuggle、launder、launder_text）、等待或对内容作出反应的变体（dormant、trigger）、自适应变体 evasive 和 capsule、依赖升级变体 dep，以及跨工具组合变体 xtool。 Fresh+IFC 中每次调用都使用新进程的方式消除了大部分遗留影响，但在 evasive、launder、pool 和 smuggle 的 15 次运行中各有 3 次仍然发生披露，而 xtool 在每次运行中都发生披露，因为单次调用仍会混合带有不同标签的条目。 消融变体 Germline-NoSplit 关闭了跨工具这一情形，但仍会通过调用内变体 evasive、launder 和 pool 发生披露，这正是声明目标拆分所弥合的缺口。 Germline 在 153 次运行中均未发生披露，并在此过程中记录了 12 次触发，这些触发为第 VII-E 节的见证评估提供了输入。 在此矩阵中，防御不以牺牲效用为代价：良性工作负载在每个运行时下都正确完成了 99 步中的 99 步，且良性发布在 Germline 下的 15 次运行中披露次数为 0。 图 3 和图 XI 中的计数包括一次攻击运行中被检测到的每一次披露，包括智能体自身做出的披露。 在没有输出标签的 Sig+Pin 下，智能体自己转发了受保护的回复：在 15 次良性发布运行中有 3 次，在 hijack 和 init_thread 的全部 6 次攻击运行中（标记为 †），工具本身并未披露任何内容。 根据第 VII-A 节的归因规则，这 6 次运行不能归因于工具，因此工具在 153 次 Sig+Pin 运行中有 108 次发生披露，与 Sig+IFC 下相同；114 与 108 之间的差距正是智能体自身的转发行为。 向量列遵循第 III-B 节的映射：十一个 V1 变体贡献了 105 次运行，trigger 向 V1+V2 贡献 15 次运行，xtool 向 V1+V3 贡献 3 次运行，两个洗钱变体向 V1+V4 贡献 30 次运行。

paragraphs.en: Remote-tool labels and CaMeL labelling check (E10). For a flow-compliant remote tool that mixes sensitivities, the worst-case reply labels of Section VII-C complete 0 public posts, with 3 attempts blocked, where per-call labels complete 2, with 1 blocked; this is the utility cost noted in Section IX-B . CaMeL labels a tool’s return value from the tool’s identity and that call’s arguments and keeps no record of earlier calls. In the check of Section VII-C , run without a language model on CaMeL’s reference interpreter at commit f083b6b , a stateful tool that the deployer declares side-effect-free returns, in its second reply, a private email body received in its first call; the reply is labelled public and passes the send_email policy to an untrusted recipient in both NORMAL and STRICT modes, while sending the private body directly is denied. CaMeL’s default policy denies the undeclared tool’s first call. For FIDES we rely on its paper’s description of per-call labelling [ 11 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 远程工具标签与 CaMeL 标签检查（E10）。 对于一个混合了不同敏感度且符合流规则的远程工具，第七章 C 节的最坏情况回复标签完成了 0 次公开帖子发布，有 3 次尝试被阻止；而每次调用的标签完成了 2 次，有 1 次被阻止；这就是第九章 B 节所指出的效用代价。 CaMeL 根据工具的身份和该次调用的参数来标注工具的返回值，并且不保留先前调用的记录。 在第七章 C 节的检查中（不使用语言模型，在 CaMeL 参考解释器的 commit f083b6b 版本上运行），一个部署者声明为无副作用的带状态工具在其第二次回复中返回了第一次调用中收到的私有邮件正文；该回复被标注为公开，并在 NORMAL 和 STRICT 两种模式下都通过了 send_email 策略而发送给不受信任的接收者，而直接发送该私有正文则被拒绝。 CaMeL 的默认策略会拒绝未声明工具的首次调用。 对于 FIDES，我们依赖其论文中关于每次调用标注的描述 [ 11 ]。

paragraphs.en: Boundary details. Table III summarises the enforcement boundary. In more detail, the initialisation allowlist covers the interpreter, libraries, CA and time-zone data, the release and the runtime, with no writable path; the broker’s environment is inherited without the http_proxy variables. Broker messages are effect , state_put and result , and requests to undeclared hosts are denied. Each release has its own broker object, a new clearance gets a new slot, and calls run sequentially; a deployment shared by several users must key slots by user as well. Host aliases are distinct destinations. Broker requests time out after 10 s or at the copy’s deadline, whichever comes first, and redirects are returned to the copy unfollowed. The deadline bounds a copy’s wall-clock time, and with it its CPU time; there is no memory quota. Absence of a request is compared, its timing is not.
paragraphs.zh: 边界细节。 表 III 总结了强制边界。 更详细地说，初始化允许列表涵盖解释器、库、CA 和时区数据、发行版以及运行时，且不含可写路径；代理（broker）的环境在继承时不包含 http_proxy 变量。 代理消息为 effect、state_put 和 result，对未声明主机的请求会被拒绝。 每个发行版都有自己的代理对象，新的许可会获得新的槽位，且调用按顺序执行；由多个用户共享的部署还必须按用户来区分槽位。 主机别名是不同的目的地。 代理请求在 10 秒后或到达副本的截止时间时超时，以先到者为准，重定向会被原样返回给副本而不被跟随。 截止时间限制副本的实际执行时间，并随之限制其 CPU 时间；没有内存配额。 缺少请求会被比较，但请求的时间点不会被比较。

sents.en: Boundary details.
sents.zh: 边界细节。

sents.en: Table III summarises the enforcement boundary.
sents.zh: 表 III 总结了强制边界。

sents.en: In more detail, the initialisation allowlist covers the interpreter, libraries, CA and time-zone data, the release and the runtime, with no writable path; the broker’s environment is inherited without the http_proxy variables.
sents.zh: 更详细地说，初始化允许列表涵盖解释器、库、CA 和时区数据、发行版以及运行时，且不含可写路径；代理（broker）的环境在继承时不包含 http_proxy 变量。

sents.en: Broker messages are effect , state_put and result , and requests to undeclared hosts are denied.
sents.zh: 代理消息为 effect、state_put 和 result，对未声明主机的请求会被拒绝。

sents.en: Each release has its own broker object, a new clearance gets a new slot, and calls run sequentially; a deployment shared by several users must key slots by user as well.
sents.zh: 每个发行版都有自己的代理对象，新的许可会获得新的槽位，且调用按顺序执行；由多个用户共享的部署还必须按用户来区分槽位。

sents.en: Host aliases are distinct destinations.
sents.zh: 主机别名是不同的目的地。

sents.en: Broker requests time out after 10 s or at the copy’s deadline, whichever comes first, and redirects are returned to the copy unfollowed.
sents.zh: 代理请求在 10 秒后或到达副本的截止时间时超时，以先到者为准，重定向会被原样返回给副本而不被跟随。

sents.en: The deadline bounds a copy’s wall-clock time, and with it its CPU time; there is no memory quota.
sents.zh: 截止时间限制副本的实际执行时间，并随之限制其 CPU 时间；没有内存配额。

sents.en: Absence of a request is compared, its timing is not.
sents.zh: 缺少请求会被比较，但请求的时间点不会被比较。

paragraphs.en: Obligations. The proofs of Appendix A rely on five implementation properties, the obligations O1 – O5 . Table XII lists for each obligation what could go wrong without it, the mechanism that discharges it, and a property test on a flow-compliant fixture that exercises it directly. Each test runs with the mechanism switched off and on, on both platforms (Landlock ABI 7 in the cloud container and ABI 4 on the server), with identical results.

paragraphs.en: Unmodified MCP servers (E7). Every call to the two tools of mcp-server-time and to mcp-server-fetch (200 per tool) and to three tools each of mcp-server-sqlite ( list_tables , describe_table , read_query ) and mcp-server-git ( git_log , git_show , git_diff_unstaged ; 30 per tool) succeeded under Germline with the same output as the unprotected server, 780 calls in total, apart from the clock value reported by get_current_time . mcp-server-git ran with /dev/null read-write in the germline; with the strict read-only binding the server cannot start, because GitPython runs git version at import and git opens /dev/null read-write. The fetch tool’s destination host comes from its URL argument, so the harness declared the host named there ( api.example ) for each call, as A5 permits. On the cloud container, with each copy in its own PID namespace, P50 latency rises from 1.4 to 49.7 ms for convert_time (15.6 ms with a pool) and from 1.2 to 47.0 ms for get_current_time (11.2 ms with a pool), from 18.4 to 110.3 ms for fetch (73.3 ms with a pool), from 1.6–2.0 to 39.0–41.2 ms for the sqlite tools and from 9.6–17.6 to 57.8–74.5 ms for the git tools.
paragraphs.zh: 未修改的 MCP 服务器（E7）。 对 mcp-server-time 的两个工具、对 mcp-server-fetch（每个工具 200 次）以及对 mcp-server-sqlite 的三个工具（list_tables、describe_table、read_query）和 mcp-server-git 的三个工具（git_log、git_show、git_diff_unstaged；每个工具 30 次）的每次调用，除 get_current_time 报告的时钟值外，均在 Germline 下成功且输出与未受保护的服务器相同，共计 780 次调用。mcp-server-git 在 germline 中以读写方式运行 /dev/null；在严格的只读绑定下该服务器无法启动，因为 GitPython 在导入时会运行 git version，而 git 会以读写方式打开 /dev/null。 fetch 工具的目标主机来自其 URL 参数，因此测试框架按照 A5 的允许，为每次调用声明了其中所命名的主机（api.example）。 在云容器上，每个副本位于各自的 PID 命名空间中，convert_time 的 P50 延迟从 1.4 ms 升至 49.7 ms（使用进程池时为 15.6 ms），get_current_time 从 1.2 ms 升至 47.0 ms（使用进程池时为 11.2 ms），fetch 从 18.4 ms 升至 110.3 ms（使用进程池时为 73.3 ms），sqlite 工具从 1.6–2.0 ms 升至 39.0–41.2 ms，git 工具从 9.6–17.6 ms 升至 57.8–74.5 ms。

paragraphs.en: Rule. Germline keeps one penalty P P per release, which starts at zero, so an authenticated update also starts at zero. On every call to the release, including calls refused while it is suppressed, the penalty first decays, P ← λ ​ P P\leftarrow\lambda P with λ = 2 − 1 / h \lambda=2^{-1/h} , and then grows by the weight of the call’s event, if any: w = 250 w=250 for an unverified event and 2000 for a verified witness from a release that declared determinism or for a broken determinism declaration ( Table XIV ). The release is suppressed once P ≥ S = 2000 P\geq S=2000 and usable again once P < R = 750 P<R=750 . The operating point is h = 50 h=50 calls and w = 250 w=250 .
paragraphs.zh: 规则。 Germline 在每个版本中维护一个惩罚值 P，初始为零，因此经过认证的更新同样从零开始。 每次对该版本的调用（包括在其被抑制期间被拒绝的调用）都会先使惩罚值衰减，P ← λP，其中 λ = 2^(−1/h)，然后按该调用事件的权重（若有的话）增长：未验证事件的 w = 250，而来自声明了确定性的版本的已验证证人事件或确定性声明被破坏的事件的权重为 2000（表 XIV）。 一旦 P ≥ S = 2000，该版本即被抑制；一旦 P < R = 750，则再次可用。 工作点为 h = 50 次调用和 w = 250。

sents.zh: 均值以速率 p ∗ = S ⁡ ( 1 − λ ) / w p^{*}=S(1-\lambda)/w 到达 S S ，在工作点处该值为 11.0 % 11.0\% 。

sents.en: This is a statement about the mean only: the penalty of a single release fluctuates around P ¯ \bar{P} , so a release whose rate lies below p ∗ p^{*} can still cross S S during a run of events, and finite-horizon probabilities must be measured, which Table XV does.
sents.zh: 这只是关于均值的陈述：单次释放的惩罚在 P ¯ \bar{P} 附近波动，因此速率低于 p ∗ p^{*} 的释放仍可能在一段事件序列中越过 S S ，且有限时域概率必须通过测量获得，表 XV 正是这样做的。

paragraphs.en: Time to suppress and recovery. From P = 0 P=0 , k k consecutive events give P = w ⁡ ( 1 − λ k ) / ( 1 − λ ) P=w(1-\lambda^{k})/(1-\lambda) , which first reaches S S at k = 9 k=9 , so a release that diverges on every call is suppressed after 9 calls. Along the expected-penalty trajectory, in which each call adds p ​ w pw , a release that diverges on 50% of its calls reaches S S after 18 calls and one at 20% after 58, while one at 10% never does, because 10 % < p ∗ 10\%<p^{*} . A verified witness from a release that declared determinism adds 2000 and suppresses the release at once. Without further events, the penalty falls from S S to R R in ⌈ h ​ log 2 ⁡ ( S / R ) ⌉ = 71 \lceil h\log_{2}(S/R)\rceil=71 calls; because refused calls also advance the decay, a suppressed release becomes usable again after 71 further call attempts, while an idle release keeps its penalty. Because the adversary controls updates and may steer the agent, it can reset the penalty with an update or speed recovery with refused calls; dampening therefore carries no guarantee, while verified witnesses remain valid evidence against the release hash they name across updates.
paragraphs.zh: 抑制与恢复所需时间。 从 P = 0 P=0 出发，k k 个连续事件给出 P = w(1−λ^k)/(1−λ) P=w(1-\lambda^{k})/(1-\lambda)，其在 k = 9 k=9 时首次达到 S S，因此在每次调用上都发散的发布会在 9 次调用后被抑制。 沿着期望惩罚的轨迹，每次调用增加 p w pw，在 50% 的调用上发散的发布会在 18 次调用后达到 S S，发散率为 20% 的在 58 次后达到，而发散率为 10% 的永远不会达到，因为 10 % < p ∗ 10\%<p^{*}。 来自声明了确定性的发布的一个经验证的见证会增加 2000，并立即抑制该发布。 若没有进一步的事件，惩罚会在 ⌈ h log₂(S/R) ⌉ = 71 \lceil h\log_{2}(S/R)\rceil=71 次调用内从 S S 降至 R R；由于被拒绝的调用也会推进衰减，被抑制的发布在再经历 71 次调用尝试后可重新变为可用，而空闲的发布则保持其惩罚不变。 由于对抗者控制更新并可能引导智能体，它可以通过更新重置惩罚，或通过被拒绝的调用加速恢复；因此阻尼不提供任何保证，而经验证的见证在跨更新时仍然是针对其所指发布哈希的有效证据。

paragraphs.en: Finite-horizon simulation. Table XV estimates the probability that a release is suppressed at least once within 1,000, 10,000 or 100,000 calls, with 2,000 simulated releases per cell (500 for 100,000 calls). Under a random schedule, each call diverges independently with probability p p ; under a bursty schedule with the same long-run rate, divergences arrive in bursts of 10 calls, during which each call diverges with probability 0.5. At 1% random divergence no release is suppressed even within 100,000 calls, and at 3% the probability is 0.15% within 1,000 calls, 2.4% within 10,000 and 23.2% within 100,000. Bursty releases are suppressed far more often at the same mean rate, because the rate inside a burst, 50%, exceeds p ∗ p^{*} ; this is a property of the policy, which reacts to the local divergence rate rather than to the long-run average.
paragraphs.zh: 有限时域模拟。 表XV估计了一次发布在1,000、10,000或100,000次调用内至少被抑制一次的概率，每个单元格进行2,000次模拟发布（100,000次调用的情形为500次）。 在随机调度下，每次调用以概率 p p 独立发生偏离；在具有相同长期速率的突发调度下，偏离以每10次调用为一批的形式到达，期间每次调用以0.5的概率发生偏离。 在1%的随机偏离下，即使经过100,000次调用也没有发布被抑制；在3%下，1,000次调用内的概率为0.15%，10,000次调用内为2.4%，100,000次调用内为23.2%。 在相同平均速率下，突发式发布被抑制的频率要高得多，因为突发内部的速率为50%，超过了 p ∗ p^{*}；这是策略的一种特性，它对局部偏离速率作出反应，而不是对长期平均值作出反应。

paragraphs.en: Parameter sweep. Fig. 5 plots p ∗ p^{*} for half-lives of 25–400 calls and weights of 100–1000. A line below the 3% reference means that the stationary mean penalty of a release diverging on 3% of its calls exceeds S S , which happens exactly in the cells with h ⋅ w ≥ 50,000 h\cdot w\geq 50{,}000 ; at the operating point, h ⋅ w = 12,500 h\cdot w=12{,}500 . A separate simulation with 800 releases per cell shows the trade-off around the operating point ( w = 250 w=250 , S = 2000 S=2000 ; probability of false suppression within 10,000 calls at 1% and 3% random divergence, and calls to suppress a release that always diverges): h = 25 h=25 gives 0% and 0% and 9 calls ( p ∗ = 22 % p^{*}=22\% ); h = 50 h=50 gives 0% and 2.9% and 9 calls ( p ∗ = 11 % p^{*}=11\% ); h = 100 h=100 gives 0% and 98% and 9 calls ( p ∗ = 5.5 % p^{*}=5.5\% ). The 2.9% at h = 50 h=50 and the 2.4% of Table XV estimate the same probability from 800 and 2,000 releases. Halving the weight instead ( w = 125 w=125 , h = 100 h=100 ) also gives 0% and 0% but needs 17 calls. The operating point h = 50 h=50 thus suppresses an always-diverging release as fast as any setting with w = 250 w=250 while keeping false suppression at 3% random divergence low within 10,000 calls; the same simulation at h = 100 h=100 is kept in e12_montecarlo_h100.json .

paragraphs.en: All experiments ran in an isolated testbed on machines we control, with test data and destination hosts set up for this study. No third-party systems, services or users were involved. MCPGuard-Dynamic was built from its public repository and run only on our own machines. The disclosure we report is a threat-model boundary of destination-based confinement, which binds authority to destinations rather than to individual items ( Section VII-B ); it does not exploit an implementation flaw in MCPGuard. Because the finding concerns a design boundary rather than a vulnerability, no vendor notification was needed. The signed attack releases and the generated-variant corpus can be used to build tools that disclose data, so we share them only through restricted access to researchers on request ( Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 所有实验均在我们控制的机器上的隔离测试环境中进行，测试数据和目标主机均为本研究专门搭建。 未涉及任何第三方系统、服务或用户。 MCPGuard-Dynamic 由其公开仓库构建，并仅在我们自己的机器上运行。 我们报告的披露是基于目标的限制这一威胁模型边界，该机制将权限绑定到目标而非单个条目（第 VII-B 节）；它并未利用 MCPGuard 的实现缺陷。 由于该发现涉及的是设计边界而非漏洞，因此无需通知供应商。 签名的攻击发布包和生成的变体语料库可用于构建泄露数据的工具，因此我们仅通过受限访问的方式，应请求分享给研究人员（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: Prototype. The artifact contains the source of Germline . Its enforcement path consists of the broker and germline fork server, the per-copy confinement (namespaces, Landlock ruleset, PID namespace per copy), Plan with declared-destination splitting and the clearance split, per-horizon state slots with their labels, and the per-copy deadline; the broker does not follow redirects. Its evidence path consists of the twin shim, the per-destination sequence comparison with positional reply replay, witness recording with the probe-replay verify() , and the dampening module. The baseline runtimes Sig+Pin, Sig+IFC, Confined+IFC, Fresh+IFC and Germline -NoSplit are implemented in the same code base and selected by configuration, as are the switches that turn each mechanism off for the implementation correspondence tests of Tables XII and VI . The property tests for O1 – O5 and the regression tests for slot labels, sequence comparison, the per-copy deadline and redirects are included with their expected outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 原型。 该工件包含 Germline 的源代码。 其执行路径由 broker 和 germline fork server、每副本的隔离（命名空间、Landlock 规则集、每副本的 PID 命名空间）、具有声明目的地拆分和许可拆分的 Plan、带有各自标签的每时间范围状态槽，以及每副本的截止时间组成；broker 不遵循重定向。 其证据路径由孪生垫片（twin shim）、带位置化回复重放的按目的地序列比较、带探针重放 verify() 的见证记录，以及阻尼模块组成。 基线运行时 Sig+Pin、Sig+IFC、Confined+IFC、Fresh+IFC 和 Germline-NoSplit 在同一代码库中实现并通过配置选择，用于在表 XII 和表 VI 的实现对应性测试中关闭各机制的开关也是如此。 针对 O1–O5 的属性测试，以及针对槽标签、序列比较、每副本截止时间和重定向的回归测试，连同其预期输出一并包含在内。

paragraphs.en: Harnesses and results. The artifact contains the scripts that run E1–E13 and the frozen result files of every experiment in Table IX : E1, E2, E3 (three passes), E4, E5, E6 (three repetitions), E7, E8-A, E8-C, E9 (existence bit and deniability), E10, E11, E12, E13 (three trials), the twin test, the obligation tests on both platforms and the regression tests. paragraphs.en: README. A top-level README gives a minimal runnable example, one scripted session of one tool server under a baseline runtime and under germline execution, with its expected output, so that a reviewer can check the installation before running the full harnesses. It states the exact versions of the kernel, Python, the Python packages and the model-serving stack used for each platform, the machine requirements of each harness and its run time, and a map from every table and figure of the paper to the result file and script it is computed from.
paragraphs.zh: README。 顶层的 README 给出一个最小可运行示例，即在基线运行时和种系执行下，某个工具服务端的一段脚本化会话，并附其预期输出，以便评审者在运行完整测试套件之前先检查安装情况。 它说明每个平台所使用的内核、Python、Python 软件包和模型服务栈的确切版本，说明每个测试套件的机器要求和运行时间，并提供一张从论文的每一张表格和每一幅图到其计算所用结果文件和脚本的映射。

paragraphs.en: MCPGuard comparison. Instead of redistributing MCPGuard-Dynamic, the artifact names its public repository and the commit we built (commit 825fdc0a , 6 Oct 2026), together with our build steps: vmlinux.h regenerated for the server kernel, one line that registers our document server in the proxy’s server table, and one build flag that includes vmlinux.h first; MCPGuard’s enforcement code is unchanged. It contains our least-privilege policies in MCPGuard’s format for the six-call session, which we used with MCPGuard’s proxy and its AgentBound reproduction. It also contains the E8-A and E8-C runner scripts, the tags of the four eBPF programs as loaded in every E8 run ( file_guard_open , net_guard_connect , proc_guard_exec and fork_guard_sched_fork ), and the positive-control transcript. With these, a reviewer can rerun the session and observe both the blocked raw-socket transfer and the disclosure through the authorised OCR destination host.
paragraphs.zh: MCPGuard 对比。 构件没有重新分发 MCPGuard-Dynamic，而是给出了其公开仓库以及我们构建所用的提交（commit 825fdc0a，2026 年 10 月 6 日），以及我们的构建步骤：为服务器内核重新生成的 vmlinux.h、在代理的服务器表中注册我们的文档服务器的一行代码，以及一个将 vmlinux.h 放在最前面包含的编译标志；MCPGuard 的强制执行代码未做改动。 它以 MCPGuard 的格式包含了我们针对六次调用会话的最小权限策略，我们将其用于 MCPGuard 的代理及其 AgentBound 复现中。 它还包含 E8-A 和 E8-C 的运行脚本、每次 E8 运行中加载的四个 eBPF 程序的标签（file_guard_open、net_guard_connect、proc_guard_exec 和 fork_guard_sched_fork），以及阳性对照的完整记录。 有了这些，审阅者可以重新运行该会话，同时观察到被拦截的原始套接字传输以及经由授权的 OCR 目的主机发生的信息泄露。

paragraphs.en: Generated-variant corpus and external components. The E13 corpus of generated variants is our own: we generated it with a locally served model (Qwen3.5-27B) through an orchestration pipeline built with an LLM coding agent (Codex), and we validated, signed and benchmarked every variant ourselves ( Section VII-C ). The artifact contains the generation pipeline with its settings and per-attempt seeds, the E13 benchmark runner, the validation procedure and the per-case results, so the funnel from 189 generation attempts to 91 validated variants and the prevention rates can be checked against the result file. Model weights (Qwen3-32B-AWQ [ 25 ] and the generator) and the serving stack (vLLM 0.11 [ 51 ] ) are obtained from their public sources and are not redistributed.
paragraphs.zh: 生成变体语料库与外部组件。 E13 生成变体语料库是我们自己的成果：我们通过一个由 LLM 编码智能体（Codex）构建的编排流水线，用本地部署的模型（Qwen3.5-27B）生成了该语料库，并自行对每个变体进行了验证、签名和基准测试（见第 VII-C 节）。 该工件包含生成流水线及其设置与每次尝试的种子、E13 基准测试运行器、验证流程以及逐案例的结果，因此可以将从 189 次生成尝试到 91 个已验证变体的漏斗过程及预防率与结果文件进行核对。 模型权重（Qwen3-32B-AWQ [25] 及生成器）和服务栈（vLLM 0.11 [51]）均取自其公开来源，并未被重新分发。

paragraphs.en: Requirements. The prototype and E1–E5, E7 and E9–E13 run on stock Linux without kernel changes; they need PID, network and IPC namespaces, Landlock and Python. The cloud container (2 vCPU) ran Linux 6.18 with Landlock ABI 7 and Python 3.13; the server ran Linux 6.8 with ABI 4 and Python 3.12. The MCPGuard comparison (E8) additionally needs the BPF LSM enabled through the kernel boot parameter. E6 needs GPUs to serve its model, and so does generating the E13 corpus anew with the generator model; we served the E6 model on NVIDIA RTX 5000 Ada GPUs with 32 GB each in a server virtual machine with 24 cores and 96 GB RAM. Running the E13 benchmark on the released corpus needs no GPU. On the server, E6 takes about 40 minutes for three repetitions, one E3 pass about 1 to 3 minutes, E13 about 1 minute per trial, and E5 and E8-C under a minute each; the README lists the run time of every harness.
paragraphs.zh: 环境要求。 原型以及 E1–E5、E7 和 E9–E13 可在未修改内核的原版 Linux 上运行；它们需要 PID、网络和 IPC 命名空间、Landlock 以及 Python。 云容器（2 个 vCPU）运行 Linux 6.18，带有 Landlock ABI 7 和 Python 3.13；服务器运行 Linux 6.8，带有 ABI 4 和 Python 3.12。 MCPGuard 对比实验（E8）还需要通过内核启动参数启用 BPF LSM。 E6 需要 GPU 来运行其模型，使用生成器模型重新生成 E13 语料库时也需要 GPU；我们在一台拥有 24 个核心和 96 GB 内存的服务器虚拟机中，在每块 32 GB 的 NVIDIA RTX 5000 Ada GPU 上运行了 E6 模型。 在已发布的语料库上运行 E13 基准测试不需要 GPU。 在服务器上，E6 三次重复约需 40 分钟，一次 E3 运行约需 1 到 3 分钟，E13 每次试验约需 1 分钟，E5 和 E8-C 各不到 1 分钟；README 列出了每个测试框架的运行时间。
